TL;DR

The Transleithanian counterpart of utils.parsing.birth_settlement (Czech lands -> settlement_id). utils.parsing.records_geo_hu places a Slovak / Rusyn birth in a 1910 járás (or chartered town); this module goes one level down, to the settlement of the 1910 Hungarian census, keyed by GISta Hungarorum's IDTel1910 (the id of every 1910 settlement in 8_MO_1865_1910_settlement.accdb, exported to data/raw/census_hu/settlements_1910/ by utils/reference_tools/places/export_gista_settlements.py).

How it works

The gazetteer (build_gazetteer_sk)

One row per 1910 settlement of a unit of the Upper-Hungary backbone (utils.parsing.districts_hu), plus every settlement today in Ukraine (Subcarpathia): its 1912 official (Hungarian) name, today's name and country (MAI NEV, MAI ORSZAG), járás and county, the 1900 gazetteer / census names and the 1904–14 official names, the centre coordinates, the 1910 population and mother tongue. The Slovak name comes from Majo (2012) (utils.parsing.lexikon_sk, settlements_hu_1910), joined inside the unit on the Majo name and a second, independent fact — the 1910 population, or the town's 1912 name — never on MAI NEV alone: MAI NEV is today's municipality, so it repeats across a merger (Stupava is also Mást), names a Hungarian town for Komárno (Komárom), and twice reads Bratislava. Where a 1910 obec is today a part of another obec, Majo's sub-part 1910.2 gives the part -> parent pair (lexikon_sk.parse_parts_sk), and the parent is what MAI NEV says.

The link (add_birth_settlement_sk_columns)

Every birth with a birth_jaras_id (after records_geo_hu.resolve_jaras_twins), legionnaire or VÚA, is linked or refused, never guessed:

(b) exact_unit the birth name (the Slovak forms of Majo, the backbone's town names, the 1912 name, the 1900 and 1904–14 variants, MAI NEV where no Majo name exists; Czech spellings of the Slovak adjectives tried as variants) names exactly one settlement of the assigned unit; (c) hungarian_* the VÚA cell's Hungarian parenthetical against 1912 names and variants within the county (bare Eperjes is Prešov, but Pozsonyeperjes is the place meant); (c') prefix_unit the name is the head of exactly one &lt;name&gt; nad/pod … settlement of the assigned unit (Stráže in the Senica unit is Stráže nad Myjavou): linked, uncertain (two refuse); (d) name_county the name is unique in another járás of the same county: linked, and birth_jaras_corrected. A unique name in another county is refused (cross_county_unique) and written to the rulings queue — Dobroč was a Brezno obec in 1880 and a Lučenec one in 1910; (b') town_city (1.0.2) a birth on a chartered town whose municipality is the town (records_geo_hu's city role) links the town's one settlement when no form of it matched; (e) fuzzy_unit no exact name anywhere (an exact namesake in another county refuses instead); one settlement of the unit scores >= 85 and no other of the county does, a name merely contained in another not counting (always uncertain); fuzzy_county the same over the county for a birth with no unit (a C3 county-only village, 1.0.1) or with no near name in its unit (1.0.2, moved; never a settlement today in Hungary). Then, with nothing found, a VÚA / legion-bracket Hungarian name unique outside the county is refused cross_county_unique and queued (1.0.1). (f) 1.1.0, each uncertain, each read only where (b)–(e) found nothing (not_found) or, for the border, refused cross_county_unique: border_unit the one settlement a name names outside the county, none inside it, links when its járás shares a stretch of boundary with the stated one (GISta MO_JarasVaros, jaras_borders); birth_jaras_corrected. Never on a cell whose two names point to two settlements (hungarian_names_another), never on a birth with no unit; the cell's county words may name the stated county or the candidate's; sound_unit / the record's name, or the cell's Hungarian name, on a coarse sound key (sound_key_sk, sound_county sound_key_hu: cs = č, sz = s, gy = ď, y = i …) names exactly one settlement of the whole gazetteer, and it lies in the unit / the county; sound_near_unit the unit's one near name on the sound key (as fuzzy_unit), none elsewhere in the county and no containing competitor; hungarian_in_unit the cell's Hungarian name names several settlements of the county but one of the unit; hyphen_part a VÚA A-B where Majo's 1910.2 gives B as a part of A and B names one settlement of the unit (of the county, for a birth with no unit: Fiačice of Gôtoväny). Two of these tiers naming two settlements refuse (ambiguous_in_county).

Guards: county words left in a cell must corroborate the settlement's county; a cell naming another land is refused (not on a bare Halič, a Novohrad járás, and never on ř/ů alone); a VÚA cell with more than one ;-separated candidate is refused (counted by the parse, not by ?); a match that holds only after stripping accents is flagged uncertain (Horná is not Horňa). Every link carries a match tier and an uncertainty flag; every refusal a reason and no settlement.

Nothing here writes data/final: build writes output/places_sk/.

The census key (correct_census_jaras_id, 1.2.0)

birth_census_jaras_id is the key notebook 02 §4b merges census_hu_jaras_1910 on: the link's unit where the link moved the járás or supplied one to a county-only birth, birth_jaras_id elsewhere; the written key stays in birth_census_jaras_id_stated. The Slovak mirror of the Czech D-247 (D-262).

A birth with no unit (a C3 county-only village) has birth_jaras_corrected <NA>, not True. Guards: a bare Halič / Stará Halič is the district anywhere in Nógrád; a land word on the record's own municipality (Bukovina, Čechy) or followed by ? does not refuse; Ukrajina is today's country, not Russia; Solnohrad beside a resolved district is Solivar's German name, not Salzburg. Legion names split on brackets, / and = (head first, the pieces as alternatives and as Hungarian names). sz / cs / zs fold in the compact key. The county-word lookups and the S2 alias forms follow records_geo_hu.DISTRICT_STRING_REPAIRS, the lookups cached on the Index. Subcarpathian links are counted from the settlement, not the land. A region word refuses only a cell with no resolved district of its own, and Podkarpatská Rus accepts a settlement of Ung (region_disagrees). A VÚA (or legion bracket) Hungarian name unique outside the county is refused cross_county_unique and queued, the queue's hungarian_name saying whether it corroborates the Slovak name's candidate (Čebovce = Csáb); the Hungarian name alone queues only when no fuzzy tier links. A C3 county-only village may take the county's one near name (fuzzy_county, uncertain). A Hungarian name found in the county but outside the unit refuses (hungarian_name_disagrees) when the Slovak name names one other settlement of the county (Lučenec (Gácz): the town, not Halič), or of anywhere when the Hungarian match is accent- or digraph-only (Širákov (Sirák): Hont, not Nógrád's Szirák). 1.0.0 (2026-11-17) First version (records_geo_hu 1.5.0, lexikon_sk 1.2.0).

def clean_name(s) -> str:
    """The raw name cell without soft-sign marks, ``?``, ``+``, brackets and a trailing comma."""
    if s is None or (not isinstance(s, str) and pd.isna(s)):
        return ""
    s = _SOFT.sub("", str(s))
    s = re.sub(r"[?+()\[\]]", " ", s)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip(" ,.;")

def compact(plain: str) -> str:
    """A plain key made compact: no spaces, and the Hungarian digraphs folded to the de-accented Slovak letter —
    old ``cz`` and ``cs`` (č) to ``c``, ``zs`` (ž) to ``z``, ``sz`` to ``s`` (1.0.1: *Biksard* = *Bikszárd*)."""
    out = plain.replace(" ", "").replace("cz", "c")
    return out.replace("cs", "c").replace("zs", "z").replace("sz", "s") if RULES["compact_digraphs"] else out

def key_acc(s) -> str:
    """Accent-keeping key: lower case, NFC, the Czech/Slovak letter pairs of :data:`_FOLD` folded, ``-`` a space."""
    t = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", clean_name(s)).lower().translate(_FOLD).replace("-", " ")
    return " ".join(t.split())

def sound_key_hu(s) -> str:
    """1.1.0: a coarse sound key of a name spelt the Hungarian way (*cs*, *cz*, *ch* = č, *zs* = ž, *sz* = s, *s* = š,
    *gy* = ď, *ny* = ň, *ly* = j, *ty* = ť, *ö*/*ő* = e, *ü*/*ű* = u, *y* = i), accents, spaces and hyphens dropped."""
    t = clean_name(s).lower().replace("-", "").replace(" ", "")
    for a, b in _HU_SOUND:
        t = t.replace(a, b)
    return _strip_accents(t)

def sound_key_sk(s) -> str:
    """1.1.0: the same sound key for a name spelt the Slovak or Czech way (*y* = i, *ä* = e, *ô* = o, *ř* = r, *ů* = u,
    *ě* = e; *ch* stays *ch*), accents, spaces and hyphens dropped."""
    t = clean_name(s).lower().replace("-", "").replace(" ", "").replace("ch", "\x02")
    for a, b in _SK_SOUND:
        t = t.replace(a, b)
    return _strip_accents(t).replace("\x02", "ch")

def name_variants(s) -> list[str]:
    """The cleaned name and its Czech -> Slovak adjective variants (lower case, accents kept), original first."""
    base = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", clean_name(s)).lower()
    if not base:
        return []
    out = [base]
    w = base.split(" ")
    if RULES["word_order"] and len(w) == 2 and _ADJ_WORD.search(w[1]) and not _ADJ_WORD.search(w[0]):
        out.append(f"{w[1]} {w[0]}")                     # 1.0.2: Štiavnica Banská = Banská Štiavnica
    for pat, reps in _ADJ_VARIANTS:
        for v in list(out):
            if re.search(pat, v):
                out += [re.sub(pat, r, v) for r in reps]
    if RULES["saint_drop"]:                              # 1.0.3: Plavecký Svätý Mikuláš = Plavecký Mikuláš
        for v in list(out):
            m = _SAINT.match(v)
            if m and _ADJ_WORD.search(m.group(1)):
                out.append(f"{m.group(1)} {m.group(2)}")
    return list(dict.fromkeys(out))

def load_gista(gista_dir: Path = GISTA_DIR) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """The exported GISta tables (every value a string), keyed by table name."""
    gista_dir = Path(gista_dir)
    man = json.loads((gista_dir / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return {t: pd.read_csv(gista_dir / v["file"], dtype=str, keep_default_na=False)
            for t, v in man["tables"].items()}

def unit_of_jaras(backbone: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, str]:
    """GISta ``IDJaras1910`` -> backbone ``unit_id``: identical, except a *tjv.* borough, which the backbone keys on
    its settlement id (``M1900`` -> ``M1900001`` Pozsony)."""
    return {u[:5]: u for u in backbone["unit_id"] if isinstance(u, str) and len(u) == 8}

def gista_settlements(gista: dict, backbone: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """One row per GISta 1910 settlement: ids, names, unit, county, population, mother tongue, coordinates."""
    m = gista["MAI_NEV_ES_ORSZAG"].rename(columns={
        "IDTel1910": "idtel", "telepulesnev_eredeti_1912": "name_1912", "IDJaras1910": "jaras_gista",
        "Jaras_1910": "jaras_hu", "IDMegye1910": "megye_id", "Megye_1910": "megye_hu", "MAI NEV": "mai_nev",
        "MAI ORSZAG": "mai_orszag", "Megyeszekhely": "megye_seat", "Jarasszekhely": "jaras_seat"})
    tjv = unit_of_jaras(backbone)
    m["unit_id"] = m["jaras_gista"].map(lambda j: tjv.get(j, j))
    e = gista["MO_1910_TER_LAK_ETN_telepulesek"].rename(columns={"id_tel_1910": "idtel", "jelen_nep": "pop_1910"})
    e = e[["idtel", "pop_1910", *TONGUES]].rename(columns=TONGUES)
    c = gista["MO_COORDINATES_settlement_CENTER"].rename(
        columns={"IDTel1910": "idtel", "FirstGeogr": "lon", "SecondGeog": "lat"})[["idtel", "lon", "lat"]]
    n = len(m)
    m = m.merge(e, on="idtel", how="left", validate="1:1").merge(c, on="idtel", how="left", validate="1:1")
    assert len(m) == n, "a GISta table join changed the settlement count"
    for col in ["pop_1910", *TONGUES.values(), "lon", "lat"]:
        m[col] = pd.to_numeric(m[col].replace("", np.nan), errors="coerce")
    m["in_backbone"] = m["unit_id"].isin(set(backbone["unit_id"]))
    return m

def gista_variants(gista: dict) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Long table ``idtel, form, source`` of the 1904–14 official names and the 1900 gazetteer and census names."""
    v = gista["MO_1900_nevvarians"]
    v = v.set_axis(["idtel", "bm1904", "jaras_bm", "hnt1900", "nep1900"], axis=1)
    long = v.melt(id_vars="idtel", value_vars=["bm1904", "hnt1900", "nep1900"], var_name="source", value_name="form")
    long = long[long["form"].str.strip() != ""]
    return long.drop_duplicates(["idtel", "form", "source"]).reset_index(drop=True)

def unit_country_shares(settlements: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Unit x today's country, the share of the unit's 1910 population (``MAI ORSZAG`` weighted by ``pop_1910``)."""
    t = settlements.pivot_table(index="unit_id", columns="mai_orszag", values="pop_1910", aggfunc="sum",
                                fill_value=0)
    return t.div(t.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan), axis=0).fillna(0)

def subcarpathian_units(settlements: pd.DataFrame, backbone: pd.DataFrame) -> frozenset[str]:
    """Backbone units most of whose 1910 population lives in today's Ukraine (``records_geo_hu.SUBCARPATHIAN_UNITS``)."""
    sh = unit_country_shares(settlements[settlements["in_backbone"]])
    ua = sh["Ukrajna"] if "Ukrajna" in sh.columns else pd.Series(0.0, index=sh.index)
    return frozenset(ua[ua > 0.5].index) & frozenset(backbone["unit_id"])

def town_surrounding_jaras(settlements: pd.DataFrame, backbone: pd.DataFrame,
                           twins: set | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
    """``{chartered town: the járás around it}`` for every town of the backbone not in *twins*
    (``records_geo_hu.TOWN_SURROUND``): the járás of the county named after the town (``jaras_hu`` = the town's
    Hungarian name + ``i``), else the járás holding >= :data:`NEAREST_MAJORITY` of the :data:`NEAREST_K` nearest
    settlements of the county (GISta centre coordinates). A town with neither is left out."""
    twins = twins or set()
    jar = backbone[backbone["unit_type"] == "járás"]
    out: dict[str, str] = {}
    for _, t in backbone[backbone["unit_type"] != "járás"].iterrows():
        if t["unit_id"] in twins:
            continue
        named = jar[(jar["megye_id"] == t["megye_id"]) & (jar["jaras_hu"].map(_norm) == _norm(f"{t['name_hu']}i"))]
        if len(named) == 1:
            out[t["unit_id"]] = named.iloc[0]["unit_id"]
            continue
        own = settlements[settlements["unit_id"] == t["unit_id"]].dropna(subset=["lat", "lon"])
        if own.empty:
            continue
        lat, lon = own["lat"].mean(), own["lon"].mean()
        cand = settlements[settlements["unit_id"].isin(set(jar.loc[jar["megye_id"] == t["megye_id"], "unit_id"]))]
        cand = cand.dropna(subset=["lat", "lon"])
        d = np.hypot((cand["lon"] - lon) * np.cos(np.radians(lat)), cand["lat"] - lat)
        vc = cand.loc[d.nsmallest(NEAREST_K).index, "unit_id"].value_counts()
        if len(vc) and vc.iloc[0] >= NEAREST_MAJORITY:
            out[t["unit_id"]] = vc.index[0]
    return out

def mai_nev_swaps(scope: pd.DataFrame, mj: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """1.0.2: settlements of one unit whose GISta ``MAI NEV`` and Majo's 1910 population disagree crosswise: Majo *X*
    is unjoined, *X* is the ``MAI NEV`` of settlement *A* and *X*'s 1910 population that of settlement *B*, while
    *B*'s ``MAI NEV`` is the unjoined Majo name *Y* whose population is *A*'s. One of the two sources has swapped
    the pair, and the Hungarian names say which (``side``): ``gista`` when **each** settlement's 1912 and 1900–14
    names are closer to the other one's ``MAI NEV`` than to its own (:func:`_closer_to_partner`: *Detrekőszentmiklós*
    999 reads *Plavecký Peter*, Majo's *Plavecký Mikuláš* has 999), else ``majo`` (*Kispaka* reads *Malá Paka*, as
    its name says: Majo's populations are the swapped side, as at *Seč*, *Kalná*, *Peťovka*). *mj* =
    :func:`join_majo`'s output. Returns ``idtel, mai_nev, majo_name_by_population, partner, side``, one row per
    settlement (*B*) of a pair."""
    cols = ["idtel", "mai_nev", "majo_name_by_population", "partner", "side"]
    g = scope[["idtel", "unit_id", "mai_nev", "pop_1910"]].assign(k=scope["mai_nev"].map(key_plain))
    m = mj.assign(k=mj["obec_sk"].map(key_plain), p=pd.to_numeric(mj["pop_total"], errors="coerce"))
    hu = scope.set_index("idtel")[[c for c in ("name_1912", "variants_1900_1914") if c in scope.columns]]
    rows = []
    for u, d in g.groupby("unit_id"):
        mu = m[m["unit_id"] == u]
        for x in mu[mu["idtel"].isna()].itertuples():
            a, b = d[d["k"] == x.k], d[d["pop_1910"] == x.p]
            if len(a) != 1 or len(b) != 1 or a.iloc[0]["idtel"] == b.iloc[0]["idtel"]:
                continue
            y = mu[(mu["k"] == b.iloc[0]["k"]) & (mu["p"] == a.iloc[0]["pop_1910"]) & mu["idtel"].isna()]
            if len(y) == 1:
                ia, ib = a.iloc[0]["idtel"], b.iloc[0]["idtel"]
                side = "gista" if _closer_to_partner(hu, ia, ib, g) and _closer_to_partner(hu, ib, ia, g) else "majo"
                rows += [(ib, b.iloc[0]["mai_nev"], x.obec_sk, ia, side)]
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=cols).drop_duplicates("idtel").reset_index(drop=True)
    if RULES["swap_reciprocal"]:                        # 1.0.3: a pair only when each row names the other back
        back = dict(zip(out["idtel"], out["partner"]))
        out = out[[back.get(q) == i for i, q in zip(out["idtel"], out["partner"])]].reset_index(drop=True)
    return out

def join_swaps(mj: pd.DataFrame, swaps: pd.DataFrame, scope: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """1.0.3 (``swap_crosswise``): for each settlement of a ``MAI NEV`` swap GISta made (``side`` gista), the unjoined
    Majo row of its unit whose name is the settlement's ``majo_name_by_population`` and whose 1910 population is the
    settlement's joins it, tier ``swap_pop`` (*Plavecký Mikuláš* 999 = Detrekőszentmiklós 999, whose ``MAI NEV`` reads
    *Plavecký Peter*). One row each side, else nothing. *mj* = :func:`join_majo`'s output (returned updated)."""
    mj = mj.copy()
    if swaps is None or swaps.empty:
        return mj
    g = scope.set_index("idtel")
    used = set(mj["idtel"].dropna())
    for r in swaps[swaps["side"] == "gista"].itertuples():
        if r.idtel in used or r.idtel not in g.index:
            continue
        pop = g.at[r.idtel, "pop_1910"]
        hit = mj[mj["idtel"].isna() & (mj["unit_id"] == g.at[r.idtel, "unit_id"])
                 & (mj["obec_sk"].map(key_plain) == key_plain(r.majo_name_by_population))
                 & (pd.to_numeric(mj["pop_total"], errors="coerce") == pop)]
        if len(hit) == 1:
            mj.loc[hit.index, ["idtel", "majo_join", "majo_gap"]] = [r.idtel, "swap_pop", pd.NA]
            used.add(r.idtel)
    return mj

def override_country(scope: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """1.0.2: ``MAI ORSZAG`` *Szlovákia* on every settlement joined to Majo (which covers present-day Slovakia only),
    except a ``town_1912`` join, the one tier that does not rest on a Slovak name (*Komárom* is in Hungary today, and
    Komárno is its Slovak half). GISta's own value stays in ``mai_orszag_gista``. Returns the overridden rows
    (``idtel, name_1912, majo_name, mai_orszag_gista``); *scope* is changed in place."""
    scope["mai_orszag_gista"] = scope["mai_orszag"]
    hit = scope["majo_name"].notna() & scope["majo_join"].ne("town_1912") & scope["mai_orszag"].ne("Szlovákia")
    over = scope.loc[hit, ["idtel", "name_1912", "majo_name", "mai_orszag_gista"]].reset_index(drop=True)
    if RULES["orszag_override"]:
        scope.loc[hit, "mai_orszag"] = "Szlovákia"
    return over

def town_other_names(settlements: pd.DataFrame, backbone: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, tuple[str, ...]]:
    """``{town unit: (MAI NEV,)}`` for every chartered town of the backbone whose one settlement lies in today's
    Slovakia and whose ``MAI NEV`` is none of the town's backbone names (``records_geo_hu.TOWN_OTHER_NAMES``:
    *Selmec- és Bélabánya* -> *Banská Belá*, the other half of the joined 1910 town; *Breznóbánya* -> *Brezno*)."""
    out = {}
    for _, t in backbone[backbone["unit_type"] != "járás"].iterrows():
        own = settlements[(settlements["unit_id"] == t["unit_id"]) & (settlements["mai_orszag"] == "Szlovákia")]
        names = {_norm(t.get(c)) for c in ("name_sk", "name_sk_alt", "name_sk_modern", "name_hu")}
        if len(own) == 1 and _norm(own.iloc[0]["mai_nev"]) not in names:
            out[t["unit_id"]] = (own.iloc[0]["mai_nev"],)
    return out

def borders_from_rings(unit_ids: list, polygons: list, grid: float = BORDER_GRID_M,
                       min_shared: int = BORDER_MIN_SHARED) -> dict[str, frozenset]:
    """1.1.0 (``border_unit``): ``{unit: the units whose polygon shares a stretch of boundary with it}``. Every ring
    vertex is snapped to a *grid* (metres, the projected coordinates of the shapefile); two units border when at least
    *min_shared* snapped vertices are theirs both — a shared edge, not a corner point. *polygons* =
    :func:`utils.parsing.spatial.read_polygons` (one list of ``(N, 2)`` rings per unit, in *unit_ids*' order)."""
    owner: dict[tuple, set] = {}
    for uid, rings in zip(unit_ids, polygons):
        for ring in rings:
            for x, y in np.round(np.asarray(ring, dtype=float) / grid).astype(np.int64):
                owner.setdefault((int(x), int(y)), set()).add(uid)
    shared: Counter = Counter()
    for units in owner.values():
        if len(units) > 1:
            shared.update(combinations(sorted(units), 2))
    out: dict[str, set] = {}
    for (a, b), n in shared.items():
        if n >= min_shared:
            out.setdefault(a, set()).add(b)
            out.setdefault(b, set()).add(a)
    return {u: frozenset(v) for u, v in out.items()}

def jaras_borders(shp_path: Path = JARAS_SHP) -> dict[str, frozenset]:
    """1.1.0: :func:`borders_from_rings` over GISta Hungarorum's 1910 ``MO_JarasVaros`` (its ``IDJaras`` is the backbone's
    ``unit_id``: a *tjv.* borough keyed on its settlement), read once per path; ``{}`` when the shapefile is absent
    (``border_unit`` then links nothing)."""
    shp_path = Path(shp_path)
    if str(shp_path) not in _BORDERS:
        if not shp_path.exists():
            return {}
        from utils.parsing.districts import read_dbf
        from utils.parsing.spatial import read_polygons
        ids = [r["IDJaras"] for r in read_dbf(shp_path.with_suffix(".dbf"), encodings=("utf-8", "cp1250", "latin-1"))]
        _BORDERS[str(shp_path)] = borders_from_rings(ids, read_polygons(shp_path))
    return _BORDERS[str(shp_path)]

def join_majo(scope: pd.DataFrame, majo: pd.DataFrame, parts: pd.DataFrame | None, backbone: pd.DataFrame, swaps: pd.DataFrame | None=None) -> pd.DataFrame

Majo rows -> GISta idtel, one to one, each pair resting on the name and a second fact.

Tiers, in order (a Majo row or a settlement taken by an earlier tier is not offered again): name_pop same unit, Majo name = MAI NEV, equal 1910 population; part_parent_pop same unit, the Majo obec is a part whose today's parent is the MAI NEV, equal population; town_1912 a Majo town row and the one settlement of its town unit, whose 1912 name is the backbone's Hungarian name of the town (Komárno = Komárom); pop_unit same unit, the one free settlement of that population (MAI NEV swapped between two neighbours: Plavecký Mikuláš / Plavecký Peter); name_pop_any_unit a Majo row with no unit (Žitný ostrov, Cserhát …), name and population equal anywhere in scope. MAI NEV alone never joins, nor a name-versus-population conflict (_join_steps), nor a Majo row of swaps (majo_label_swaps) on a tier that rests on the population alone (part_parent_pop, pop_unit): where the name joins too, GISta confirms the 1910 label (Setechov, Lietavská Lúčka: the disagreement lies in Majo's earlier rows), and a town joins on its 1912 name (Banská Štiavnica / Krupina: Majo's 1910.1 figures are swapped, the names are not — majo_pop is then not the town's). Returns majo with majo_row, idtel, majo_join (&lt;NA&gt; + majo_gap where unjoined) and majo_label_swap.

def join_majo(scope: pd.DataFrame, majo: pd.DataFrame, parts: pd.DataFrame | None,
              backbone: pd.DataFrame, swaps: pd.DataFrame | None = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Majo rows -> GISta ``idtel``, one to one, each pair resting on the name **and** a second fact.

    Tiers, in order (a Majo row or a settlement taken by an earlier tier is not offered again):
    ``name_pop`` same unit, Majo name = ``MAI NEV``, equal 1910 population; ``part_parent_pop`` same unit, the
    Majo obec is a *part* whose today's parent is the ``MAI NEV``, equal population; ``town_1912`` a Majo town
    row and the one settlement of its town unit, whose 1912 name is the backbone's Hungarian name of the town
    (Komárno = *Komárom*); ``pop_unit`` same unit, the one free settlement of that population (``MAI NEV``
    swapped between two neighbours: *Plavecký Mikuláš* / *Plavecký Peter*); ``name_pop_any_unit`` a Majo row
    with no unit (Žitný ostrov, Cserhát …), name and population equal anywhere in scope. ``MAI NEV`` alone never
    joins, nor a name-versus-population conflict (:func:`_join_steps`), nor a Majo row of *swaps*
    (:func:`majo_label_swaps`) on a tier that rests on the population alone (``part_parent_pop``, ``pop_unit``):
    where the name joins too, GISta confirms the 1910 label (*Setechov*, *Lietavská Lúčka*: the disagreement
    lies in Majo's earlier rows), and a town joins on its 1912 name (*Banská Štiavnica* / *Krupina*: Majo's
    1910.1 figures are swapped, the names are not — ``majo_pop`` is then not the town's). Returns *majo* with ``majo_row``, ``idtel``, ``majo_join`` (``<NA>`` +
    ``majo_gap`` where unjoined) and ``majo_label_swap``.
    """
    mj = majo.reset_index(drop=True).copy()
    mj["majo_row"] = mj.index
    mj["k"] = mj["obec_sk"].map(key_plain)
    mj["pop"] = pd.to_numeric(mj["pop_total"], errors="coerce")
    mj["majo_label_swap"] = _swap_flags(mj, swaps)
    g = scope[["idtel", "unit_id", "megye_id", "name_1912", "mai_nev", "pop_1910"]].copy()
    g["k"] = g["mai_nev"].map(key_plain)
    by_unit = {u: d for u, d in g.groupby("unit_id")}
    mj["megye"] = mj["unit_id"].map(g.drop_duplicates("unit_id").set_index("unit_id")["megye_id"])
    county_keys: dict[str, dict[str, set]] = {}
    for m, k, i in zip(g["megye_id"], g["k"], g["idtel"]):
        county_keys.setdefault(m, {}).setdefault(k, set()).add(i)
    town_hu = {r["unit_id"]: _norm(r["name_hu"]) for _, r in backbone.iterrows() if r["unit_type"] != "járás"}
    joined: dict[int, tuple[str, str]] = {}
    used: set[str] = set()
    majo_keys = mj.groupby("unit_id")["k"].agg(set).to_dict()
    free, named_ok = mj[~mj["majo_label_swap"]], set()
    for tier, pick in _join_steps(_parent_keys(parts), town_hu, used, majo_keys, county_keys, named_ok).items():
        pairs = []
        rows = free if tier in ("part_parent_pop", "pop_unit") else mj
        for r in rows[rows["unit_id"].notna()].itertuples():
            if r.majo_row not in joined:
                pairs += [(r.majo_row, i) for i in pick(r, by_unit.get(r.unit_id, g.iloc[0:0]))["idtel"]]
        _claim(pairs, tier, joined, used)
        if tier == "name_pop":
            named_ok |= {i for i, t in joined.values() if t == "name_pop"}
    pairs = [(r.majo_row, i) for r in mj[mj["unit_id"].isna()].itertuples()
             for i in g.loc[(g["k"] == r.k) & (g["pop_1910"] == r.pop), "idtel"]]
    _claim(pairs, "name_pop_any_unit", joined, used)
    mj["idtel"] = mj["majo_row"].map(lambda r: joined[r][0] if r in joined else pd.NA)
    mj["majo_join"] = mj["majo_row"].map(lambda r: joined[r][1] if r in joined else pd.NA)
    mj["majo_gap"] = [_majo_gap(r, by_unit, county_keys) if pd.isna(r.idtel) else pd.NA for r in mj.itertuples()]
    return mj.drop(columns=["k", "pop", "megye"])

def majo_label_swaps(majo: pd.DataFrame, earlier: pd.DataFrame | None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Majo 1910.1 rows whose names are swapped: an obec whose 1910 population is off the median of its own
    1880–1900 rows by :data:`SWAP_OFF_FACTOR` or more, where exactly one other such obec of the county fits — its
    1910 population within :data:`SWAP_FIT_FACTOR` of this one's earlier median, and the reverse (*Andrejová*
    386/389/379 then 136, *Ondrašovce* 134/156/152 then 401). *majo* = ``settlements_hu_1910``; *earlier* =
    :func:`lexikon_sk.parse_earlier_years`. A name the county holds twice in any year is not checked. Returns the
    flagged 1910.1 rows (``obec_sk, okres_sk, zupa_sk, pop_total``) with ``median_1880_1900`` and ``partner``."""
    cols = ["obec_sk", "okres_sk", "zupa_sk", "pop_total", "median_1880_1900", "partner"]
    if earlier is None or earlier.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=cols)

    def keyed(df):
        df = df[df["unit_type"].isin(["obec", "town"])]
        return df.assign(_z=df["zupa_sk"].map(_norm), _n=df["obec_sk"].map(key_plain))
    cur, old = keyed(majo), keyed(earlier)
    dup = set(map(tuple, cur.loc[cur.duplicated(["_z", "_n"], keep=False), ["_z", "_n"]].values)) | \
        set(map(tuple, old.loc[old.duplicated(["_z", "_n", "year"], keep=False), ["_z", "_n"]].values))
    med = old.groupby(["_z", "_n"])["pop_total"].median()
    cur = cur[[(z, n) not in dup for z, n in zip(cur["_z"], cur["_n"])]].copy()
    cur["median_1880_1900"] = [med.get((z, n)) for z, n in zip(cur["_z"], cur["_n"])]
    p, m = pd.to_numeric(cur["pop_total"], errors="coerce"), pd.to_numeric(cur["median_1880_1900"])
    off = cur[((p / m) >= SWAP_OFF_FACTOR) | ((m / p) >= SWAP_OFF_FACTOR)].copy()
    partner = {}
    for _, grp in off.groupby("_z"):
        for i, r in grp.iterrows():
            hits = [j for j, q in grp.iterrows() if j != i and _fits(r["pop_total"], q["median_1880_1900"])
                    and _fits(q["pop_total"], r["median_1880_1900"])]
            if len(hits) == 1:
                partner[i] = grp.at[hits[0], "obec_sk"]
    off["partner"] = off.index.map(partner)
    return off.loc[off["partner"].notna(), cols].reset_index(drop=True)

def build_gazetteer_sk(backbone: pd.DataFrame, majo: pd.DataFrame, parts: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
                       gista: dict | None = None, earlier: pd.DataFrame | None = None) -> dict:
    """``{"gazetteer", "forms", "majo_join", "parts", "label_swaps", "subcarpathian_units", "town_surround"}``.

    *majo* = ``data/final/geo/settlements_hu_1910`` (lexikon_sk.build_crosswalk_sk); *parts* =
    :func:`lexikon_sk.parse_parts_sk` (or ``None``: tier ``part_parent_pop`` then joins nothing); *earlier* =
    :func:`lexikon_sk.parse_earlier_years` (or ``None``: no label-swap check)."""
    from utils.parsing import records_geo_hu as rgh
    gista = load_gista() if gista is None else gista
    alls = gista_settlements(gista, backbone)
    scope = gazetteer_scope(alls)
    swaps = majo_label_swaps(majo, earlier if RULES["label_swaps"] else None)
    mj = join_majo(scope, majo, parts, backbone, swaps)
    var = gista_variants(gista)
    scope["variants_1900_1914"] = scope["idtel"].map(
        var.groupby("idtel")["form"].agg(lambda s: "; ".join(dict.fromkeys(s))))
    nev_swaps = mai_nev_swaps(scope, mj)                    # 1.0.2: crosswise MAI NEV swaps, GISta's side
    if RULES["swap_crosswise"]:                             # 1.0.3: GISta's swap joins Majo crosswise (swap_pop)
        mj = join_swaps(mj, nev_swaps, scope)
    one = mj.dropna(subset=["idtel"]).set_index("idtel")
    scope["majo_name"] = scope["idtel"].map(one["obec_sk"])
    scope["majo_join"] = scope["idtel"].map(one["majo_join"])
    scope["majo_pop"] = scope["idtel"].map(one["pop_total"])
    sub = subcarpathian_units(alls, backbone)
    scope["subcarpathian"] = scope["unit_id"].isin(sub) | (~scope["in_backbone"] & (scope["mai_orszag"] == "Ukrajna"))
    over = override_country(scope)                          # 1.0.2: Majo-joined = today's Slovakia
    scope["mai_nev_swapped"] = scope["idtel"].isin(set(nev_swaps.loc[nev_swaps["side"] == "gista", "idtel"]))
    meta = backbone.drop_duplicates("unit_id").set_index("unit_id")
    scope["unit_name_sk"] = scope["unit_id"].map(meta["name_sk"])
    scope["unit_type"] = scope["unit_id"].map(meta["unit_type"])
    twins = set(rgh.build_jaras_twin_pairs(backbone))
    return {"gazetteer": scope.reset_index(drop=True), "forms": _forms(scope, var, backbone), "majo_join": mj,
            "parts": parts, "label_swaps": swaps, "subcarpathian_units": sub, "mai_orszag_overrides": over,
            "mai_nev_swaps": nev_swaps, "town_surround": town_surrounding_jaras(alls, backbone, twins)}

def cell_head(raw) -> str:
    """A VÚA cell without its parentheses (the card's own text, before the editor's readings)."""
    if raw is None or (not isinstance(raw, str) and pd.isna(raw)):
        return ""
    s = str(raw)
    while _PAREN.search(s):
        s = _PAREN.sub(" ", s)
    return s.replace("(", " ").replace(")", " ")

def another_land(text, halic_unit: bool = False, muni_key: str = "", district: bool = False) -> str | None:
    """The land a cell names when it is not the Hungarian frame (records_geo's markers + the Czech lands); ``None``
    else. Never on a Czech letter (ř, ů) alone, never on a bare *Halič* / *Stará Halič* piece when the birth sits
    in Nógrád (*halic_unit*: the Halič járás, or anywhere in the county since 1.0.1), never on the record's own
    municipality (*muni_key*) or a word followed by ``?`` (:func:`_guard_text`). *Ukrajina* alone is today's
    country, not Russia; *Solnohrad* beside a resolved district (*district*) is Solivar (German *Salzburg*)."""
    new = RULES["land_guards"]
    raw = _guard_text(text, muni_key) if new else str(text)
    k = _norm(raw)
    if not k:
        return None
    if _CZECH_LAND_WORDS.search(k):
        return "Czech lands"
    for rx, land in _LAND_MARKER_RES:
        if land not in OTHER_LANDS or not rx.search(k):
            continue
        if land == "Galicia" and halic_unit and _bare_halic(raw, new):
            continue
        if not new:
            return land
        if land == "Russia" and not rx.search(re.sub(r"(?<![a-z])ukrajin\w*", " ", k)):
            continue                                     # 1.0.1: Ukrajina is the record's modern-country note
        if land == "Austria" and district and not rx.search(re.sub(r"(?<![a-z])solnohrad\w*", " ", k)):
            continue                                     # 1.0.1: Solnohrad, okres Prešov = Solivar (Salzburg)
        return land
    return None

def hungarian_names(raw) -> list[str]:
    """The names in a VÚA cell's parentheses that are not readings: ``(dříve: Somosújfalu)``, ``(Szölös;
    Nagyszöllös)``, ``(Farkasudvar, Farkas-Dovorán)``. A part naming an okres is a reading, one marked
    ``nesprávně`` (wrong) is dropped, a trailing ``- ?`` is removed."""
    out: list[str] = []
    s = "" if raw is None or (not isinstance(raw, str) and pd.isna(raw)) else str(raw)
    for grp in re.findall(r"\(([^()]*)\)", s):
        items = [i for i in grp.split(";")                  # an item naming an okres is a reading, and one
                 if not re.search(r"\bokr(?:es|\.)?\b|nesprávně|nespravne", i, re.IGNORECASE)]   # marked wrong
        for part in (p for i in items for p in i.split(",")):
            p = part.strip()
            if not p:
                continue
            if RULES["hungarian_labels"]:                 # 1.0.2: a label run, colon or not (dříve: též X)
                p = _HU_LABELS.sub("", p)
            else:
                p = re.sub(r"^(?:dříve(?:\s+též)?|též|dnes)\s*:\s*", "", p, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
            p = re.sub(r"\s*-?\s*\?+\s*$", "", p).strip(" -")
            if re.search(r"[A-Za-zÀ-ž]{3,}", p):
                out.append(p)
    return list(dict.fromkeys(out))

class Index:
    """The gazetteer's name forms by (source group, key kind) -> key -> ids, and the ids by unit and county."""

    GROUPS = {"slovak": ("majo", "backbone"), "today": ("mai_nev",), "hungarian": HUNGARIAN_SOURCES}

    def __init__(self, gz: pd.DataFrame, forms: pd.DataFrame, backbone: pd.DataFrame,
                 parts: pd.DataFrame | None = None):
        self.gz = gz.set_index("idtel")
        if RULES["mai_nev_swaps"] and "mai_nev_swapped" in gz.columns:     # 1.0.2: a swapped MAI NEV names nothing
            swapped = set(gz.loc[gz["mai_nev_swapped"].astype(bool), "idtel"])
            forms = forms[~(forms["source"].eq("mai_nev") & forms["idtel"].isin(swapped))]
        self.by: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, set]] = {}
        for grp, srcs in self.GROUPS.items():
            f = forms[forms["source"].isin(srcs)]
            for kind in ("key_acc", "key_plain", "key_compact"):
                d: dict[str, set] = {}
                vals = f["key_plain"].map(compact) if kind == "key_compact" else f[kind]
                for k, i in zip(vals, f["idtel"]):
                    if k:
                        d.setdefault(k, set()).add(i)
                self.by[(grp, kind)] = d
        self.unit = gz.groupby("unit_id")["idtel"].agg(set).to_dict()
        meta = backbone.drop_duplicates("unit_id").set_index("unit_id")["megye_id"]
        self.megye_of_unit = meta.to_dict()
        gz_m = gz["unit_id"].map(self.megye_of_unit).fillna(gz["megye_id"])
        self.megye_of = dict(zip(gz["idtel"], gz_m))
        self.county = pd.Series(list(self.megye_of.keys())).groupby(pd.Series(list(self.megye_of.values()))) \
            .agg(set).to_dict()
        self.all = set(gz["idtel"])
        names = backbone["name_sk"] if "name_sk" in backbone.columns else pd.Series("", index=backbone.index)
        self.halic_units = set(backbone.loc[names.map(_norm).eq("halic"), "unit_id"])
        sl = forms[forms["source"].isin(("majo", "backbone", "mai_nev"))]
        self.fuzzy_keys = sl.groupby("idtel")["key_plain"].agg(set).to_dict()
        self.slovak_keys = sl[["idtel", "key_plain"]].drop_duplicates()
        self.slovak_heads = _form_heads(sl)
        self.lookups = county_lookups(backbone) if "name_sk" in backbone.columns else None
        self.town_units = set(backbone.loc[backbone["unit_type"] != "járás", "unit_id"])
        self.hungary_today = set(gz.loc[gz["mai_orszag"].isin(HUNGARY_TODAY), "idtel"]) \
            if "mai_orszag" in gz.columns else set()
        self._sound_index(forms)
        self.part_parents = _part_parents(parts)
        self._borders: dict | None = None

    def _sound_index(self, forms: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
        """1.1.0: ``sound_ids`` (sound key -> settlements) and ``sound_keys`` (settlement -> its sound keys) over every
        form — a Hungarian form on :func:`sound_key_hu`, any other on :func:`sound_key_sk`, and ``MAI NEV`` on both (today's
        Ukrainian names are Hungarian-spelt transliterations)."""
        hu = forms["source"].isin(HUNGARIAN_SOURCES)
        keys = [sound_key_hu(f) if h else sound_key_sk(f) for f, h in zip(forms["form"], hu)]
        ids = list(forms["idtel"])
        mai = forms[forms["source"].eq("mai_nev")]
        keys += [sound_key_hu(f) for f in mai["form"]]
        ids += list(mai["idtel"])
        self.sound_ids: dict[str, set] = {}
        self.sound_keys: dict[str, set] = {}
        for k, i in zip(keys, ids):
            if k:
                self.sound_ids.setdefault(k, set()).add(i)
                self.sound_keys.setdefault(i, set()).add(k)

    @property
    def borders(self) -> dict:
        """1.1.0 (``border_unit``): ``{unit: bordering units}`` (:func:`jaras_borders`), read on first use; a test may
        set it."""
        if self._borders is None:
            self._borders = jaras_borders()
        return self._borders

    @borders.setter
    def borders(self, value: dict) -> None:
        self._borders = value

    def sound_exact(self, names: list[str], hu: list[str]) -> tuple[set, str | None]:
        """1.1.0 (``sound_exact``): ``(settlements, group)`` the record's names (:func:`sound_key_sk`) and the cell's
        Hungarian names (:func:`sound_key_hu`) name on the sound key, over the whole gazetteer; *group* ``hungarian``
        when only a Hungarian name reached them, else ``slovak``."""
        sk = {sound_key_sk(n) for n in names if key_plain(n)} - {""}
        hk = {sound_key_hu(h) for h in hu} - {""}
        by_sk = set().union(*[self.sound_ids.get(k, set()) for k in sk]) if sk else set()
        by_hu = set().union(*[self.sound_ids.get(k, set()) for k in hk]) if hk else set()
        return by_sk | by_hu, ("slovak" if by_sk else "hungarian" if by_hu else None)

    def sound_near(self, name: str, region: set, county: set) -> str | None:
        """1.1.0 (``sound_near``): the one settlement of *county* scoring >= :data:`FUZZY_CUTOFF` on the sound key
        (:func:`sound_key_sk` of the record name, of :data:`SOUND_MIN_LEN` letters or more), when it lies in *region*
        and no other settlement of the county has a sound key that holds the record's, or is held by it, with two
        letters to spare (both keys :data:`SOUND_MIN_LEN` long or more: a containing name competes, as in
        :meth:`fuzzy_scan`). A held or holding key never scores."""
        k = sound_key_sk(name)
        if len(k) < SOUND_MIN_LEN:
            return None
        hits, contained = [], set()
        for i in county:
            best = 0.0
            for x in self.sound_keys.get(i, ()):
                if (k in x or x in k) and abs(len(x) - len(k)) >= 2:
                    if min(len(x), len(k)) >= SOUND_MIN_LEN:
                        contained.add(i)
                    continue
                best = max(best, fuzz.ratio(k, x))
            if best >= FUZZY_CUTOFF:
                hits.append(i)
        if len(hits) != 1 or hits[0] not in region or contained - set(hits):
            return None
        return hits[0]

    def hyphen_part(self, muni, region: set) -> str | None:
        """1.1.0 (``hyphen_part``): a VÚA municipality ``A-B`` (an unspaced hyphen, two pieces) where Majo's 1910.2 parts
        give *B* as a part of *A* (*Gôtoväny-Fiačice*: Fiačice, today a part of Gôtoväny): the one settlement of
        *region* *B* names (by name, every form), else ``None``."""
        if not isinstance(muni, str):
            return None
        pieces = [p.strip() for p in _HYPHEN.split(clean_name(muni))]
        if len(pieces) != 2 or not all(pieces) or not region:
            return None
        a, b = pieces
        parents = set().union(*[self.part_parents.get(key_plain(v), set()) for v in name_variants(b)])
        if not parents & {key_plain(v) for v in name_variants(a)}:
            return None
        s, _, _ = self.search([b], region)
        return next(iter(s)) if len(s) == 1 else None

    def prefix(self, names: list[str], region: set) -> set:
        """1.0.1 (``prefix_unit``): the settlements of *region* a Slovak or today's name of which starts with a
        record name plus a space (*Stráže* -> *Stráže nad Myjavou*); names under :data:`PREFIX_MIN_LEN` letters
        none. 1.0.2 (``prefix_heads``): only the head of a ``<name> nad/pod/pri …`` form or of a double-name obec
        (*Zárieč - Keblov*), :func:`_form_heads`; (``county_adjective``) also the one ``<county adjective> <name>``
        form (*Liptovská Porúbka*)."""
        keys = {key_plain(v) for n in names for v in name_variants(n) if len(key_plain(v)) >= PREFIX_MIN_LEN}
        if not keys or not region:
            return set()
        out: set = set()
        if RULES["prefix_heads"]:
            h = self.slovak_heads[self.slovak_heads["idtel"].isin(region)]
            out |= set(h.loc[h["head"].isin(keys), "idtel"])
        else:
            heads = {k + " " for k in keys}
            f = self.slovak_keys[self.slovak_keys["idtel"].isin(region)]
            out |= set(f.loc[f["key_plain"].map(lambda k: any(k.startswith(x) for x in heads)), "idtel"])
        if RULES["county_adjective"]:
            h = self.slovak_heads[self.slovak_heads["idtel"].isin(region)]
            out |= set(h.loc[h["adj_tail"].isin(keys), "idtel"])
        return out

    def search(self, names: list[str], region: set, groups=("slovak", "today", "hungarian")):
        """``(ids, group, accent_only)``: the first group with a hit in *region*, accent-keeping keys before plain."""
        variants = [v for n in names for v in name_variants(n)]
        for grp in groups:
            for kind, accent_only in (("key_acc", False), ("key_plain", True), ("key_compact", True)):
                keyf = {"key_acc": key_acc, "key_plain": key_plain, "key_compact": key_compact}[kind]
                hits = set().union(*[self.by[(grp, kind)].get(keyf(v), set()) for v in variants]) & region \
                    if variants else set()
                if hits:
                    return hits, grp, accent_only
        return set(), None, False

    def fuzzy(self, name: str, region: set, county: set) -> str | None:
        """The one settlement of *region* scoring >= :data:`FUZZY_CUTOFF`, when no other of *county* does. A name
        that only gains or loses a syllable around the other (*Kostolany* inside *Zakostoľany*) is another word,
        not a spelling: a key contained in the other with two letters or more to spare does not count. Since 1.0.3
        (``fuzzy_contained``) such a containing name that shares a word of :data:`FUZZY_SHARED_WORD` letters with the
        record is a competitor (:meth:`fuzzy_scan`), and a competitor leaves no pick."""
        hits, comps = self.fuzzy_scan(name, county)
        return hits[0] if len(hits) == 1 and hits[0] in region and not comps else None

    def fuzzy_scan(self, name: str, county: set) -> tuple[list, list]:
        """``(hits, competitors)`` of *county* for the record *name* (:meth:`fuzzy`): the settlements scoring >=
        :data:`FUZZY_CUTOFF` on a form, and (1.0.3 ``fuzzy_contained``) the others with a form that holds the record's
        key, or is held by it, with two letters to spare and shares a word of :data:`FUZZY_SHARED_WORD` letters or more
        with it (*Šutovce*: *Dolné Šútovce*; *Bystrica*: *Banská Bystrica*; *Velké Volkovce*: *Volkovce*) — unless the
        near names carry that word themselves (a word of theirs starts with its stem: *Stebník-Húta* is *Stebnícka
        Huta*, not *Stebník*)."""
        k = key_plain(name)
        if len(k) < 5:
            return [], []
        words = _long_words(k)
        hits, shared = [], {}
        for i in county:
            best, common = 0.0, set()
            for x in self.fuzzy_keys.get(i, {""}):
                if (k in x or x in k) and abs(len(x) - len(k)) >= 2:
                    common |= (words & _long_words(x)) if RULES["fuzzy_contained"] else set()
                    continue
                best = max(best, fuzz.ratio(k, x))
            if best >= FUZZY_CUTOFF:
                hits.append(i)
            elif common:
                shared[i] = common
        # a shared word the near name carries too (its stem starts a word of it) is no evidence against it: Borský
        # Svätý Jur keeps Borský Svätý Jur beside Svätý Jur, Lehotka pod Brehy its Lehôtka pod Brehmi beside Brehy
        hit_words = {w for i in hits for x in self.fuzzy_keys.get(i, ()) for w in x.replace("-", " ").split()}
        comps = [i for i, ws in shared.items() if any(not any(h.startswith(w[:-1]) for h in hit_words) for w in ws)]
        return sorted(hits), sorted(comps)

def adjective_only(name) -> bool:
    """1.0.3 (``fuzzy_adjective_only``): every word of *name* is a positional or size adjective (*Horné*, *Veľké*) or a
    county adjective (*Spišský*, records_geo_hu's reader) — a name too thin for a near-name match."""

def county_words(text, backbone: pd.DataFrame, lookups: tuple | None = None) -> set[str]:
    """The counties a cell's pieces name — a district (its county) or a county form, through records_geo_hu's own
    lookups (``Abauj Torňa``, ``župa Zemplínska``, ``Trenčín``). Empty when the cell names none. *lookups* =
    :func:`county_lookups` (built here when not given); the S2 county-adjective reader only with
    ``records_geo_hu.DISTRICT_STRING_REPAIRS`` on."""
    from utils.parsing import records_geo_hu as rgh
    unit_lut, megye_lut, meta = lookups if lookups is not None else county_lookups(backbone)
    s2 = getattr(rgh, "_county_key_s2", None) if getattr(rgh, "DISTRICT_STRING_REPAIRS", False) else None
    out: set[str] = set()
    for p in _PIECES.split(str(text or "")):
        k = re.sub(r"^(?:okres|okr\.?|župa|zupa)\s+", "", _norm(clean_name(p))).strip(" .")
        if not k or k in rgh._AMBIGUOUS_SEATS:
            continue
        if k in unit_lut:
            out.add(meta[unit_lut[k][0]])
            continue
        ck = rgh._county_key(k)
        noun = ck if ck in megye_lut else (s2(k) if s2 else None)
        if noun in megye_lut:
            out.add(megye_lut[noun])
    return out

def link_one(names: list[str], hu: list[str], unit, megye, idx: Index) -> dict:
    """The settlement rules (b)–(e) for one birth: *names* the record's reading(s), *hu* the VÚA cell's Hungarian
    names, *unit* the assigned járás/town (``None``: county only), *megye* its county."""
    if not any(key_plain(n) for n in names):
        return _refuse("no_municipality")
    in_unit = idx.unit.get(unit, set()) if unit else set()
    in_county = idx.county.get(megye, set())
    s, grp, acc = idx.search(names, in_unit) if in_unit else (set(), None, False)
    h, _, h_acc = idx.search(hu, in_county, groups=("hungarian",)) if hu else (set(), None, False)
    if len(s) > 1:
        return _refuse("ambiguous_in_unit", detail="; ".join(sorted(s)))
    if len(s) == 1:
        sid = next(iter(s))
        if len(h) == 1 and h != s:
            return _refuse("hungarian_name_disagrees", next(iter(h)), detail=sid)
        hungarian = grp == "hungarian"
        conflict = hungarian and RULES["name_conflict"] and _slovak_elsewhere(names, sid, in_county, idx) is not None
        return _link(sid, "exact_unit_hungarian" if hungarian else "exact_unit", grp, acc, unit, idx, conflict)
    if len(h) == 1:
        return _hungarian_link(names, next(iter(h)), h_acc, unit, in_unit, in_county, idx)
    pre = idx.prefix(names, in_unit) if RULES["prefix_unit"] else set()   # 1.0.1: Stráže nad Myjavou
    if len(pre) == 1:
        return _link(next(iter(pre)), "prefix_unit", "slovak", False, unit, idx)
    if len(pre) > 1:
        return _refuse("ambiguous_in_unit", detail="; ".join(sorted(pre)))
    c, grp, acc = idx.search(names, in_county - in_unit)
    if len(c) == 1:
        return _link(next(iter(c)), "name_county", grp, acc, unit, idx)
    if len(c) > 1:
        return _refuse("ambiguous_in_county", detail="; ".join(sorted(c)))
    out = _outside_county(names, hu, in_county, idx)
    if out is not None:
        return out
    eh = idx.search(hu, idx.all - in_county, groups=("hungarian",))[0] if hu and RULES["hungarian_queue"] else set()
    out = _fuzzy_tiers(names[0], unit, in_unit, in_county, idx)
    if out is not None and RULES["fuzzy_hungarian_guard"] and (out["sid"] or out["refused_sid"]) is not None:
        # 1.0.3: the cell's Hungarian name names one settlement outside the county, not the near name (Kis-Rát); a
        # bracketed name that is a Slovak name somewhere is an okres alternative, not a Hungarian name (Poprad?)
        hu_only = [h for h in hu if not idx.search([h], idx.all, groups=("slovak",))[0]]
        eg = idx.search(hu_only, idx.all - in_county, groups=("hungarian",))[0] if hu_only else set()
        if len(eg) == 1:
            return _refuse("cross_county_unique", next(iter(eg)), detail="hungarian_names_another")
    if out is not None:
        return out
    if len(eh) == 1:                                        # nothing else found: queued, never linked
        return _refuse("cross_county_unique", next(iter(eh)), detail="hungarian_only")
    return _refuse("not_found")

def split_legion_name(muni) -> tuple[str, list[str]]

1.0.1: a legion municipality split on brackets, / and = into its head and the other pieces (Horný Štefanov (Horní Štepanov), Michalovce /Velké Michalovice/, Most na Ostrove (Dunadihas)), and since 1.0.2 (legion_dash_split) on a spaced hyphen (Ersekujvar - Nové Zámky). The head is searched first, the pieces as alternatives and — as on the VÚA side — as Hungarian names within the county; two of them naming different settlements refuse as any two names do. A leading bracket is a qualifier of the name after it, not a name: (Nižní) Domanince is searched as Nižní Domanince, then Domanince. ("", []) for no name.

def split_legion_name(muni) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
    """1.0.1: a legion municipality split on brackets, ``/`` and ``=`` into its head and the other pieces
    (*Horný Štefanov (Horní Štepanov)*, *Michalovce /Velké Michalovice/*, *Most na Ostrove (Dunadihas)*), and since
    1.0.2 (``legion_dash_split``) on a spaced hyphen (*Ersekujvar - Nové Zámky*). The
    head is searched first, the pieces as alternatives and — as on the VÚA side — as Hungarian names within the
    county; two of them naming different settlements refuse as any two names do. A leading bracket is a
    qualifier of the name after it, not a name: *(Nižní) Domanince* is searched as *Nižní Domanince*, then
    *Domanince*. ``("", [])`` for no name."""
    if not isinstance(muni, str):
        return "", []
    lead = re.match(r"\s*\(([^()]*)\)\s*(.+)$", muni)
    if lead:                                              # (Velké) Šurany: the bracket qualifies what follows
        rest = split_legion_name(lead.group(2))
        whole = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", f"{lead.group(1)} {rest[0]}").strip(" ,.;-")
        return (whole, list(dict.fromkeys([rest[0], *rest[1]]))) if rest[0] else ("", [])
    split = re.compile(f"{_LEGION_SPLIT.pattern}|{_DASH.pattern}") if RULES["legion_dash_split"] else _LEGION_SPLIT
    parts = [re.sub(r"\s+", " ", p).strip(" ,.;-") for p in split.split(muni)]
    parts = [p for p in parts if re.search(r"[A-Za-zÀ-ž]{3,}", p)]
    if not parts:
        return "", []
    return parts[0], list(dict.fromkeys(parts[1:]))

def link_row(r: dict, dataset: str, idx: Index, backbone: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
    """One person row -> the link dict (``sid`` or ``refusal``), the guards applied around :func:`link_one`."""
    names, hu, text, q = _row_inputs(r, dataset)
    unit = r.get("birth_jaras_id") if isinstance(r.get("birth_jaras_id"), str) else None
    megye = idx.megye_of_unit.get(unit, r.get("birth_megye_id"))
    muni = r.get("birth_municipality")
    own, _, _ = idx.search([muni], idx.county.get(megye, set())) if isinstance(muni, str) else (set(), None, False)
    district = str(r.get("birth_jaras_match")) in ("jaras", "town", "fuzzy", "megye")
    nograd = megye == NOGRAD and RULES["land_guards"]
    land = another_land(text, halic_unit=unit in idx.halic_units or nograd,
                        muni_key=key_plain(muni) if own else "", district=district)
    if land is not None:
        out = _refuse("another_land", detail=land)
    elif dataset == "vua" and pd.notna(r.get("birth_n_candidates")) and int(r["birth_n_candidates"]) > 1:
        out = _refuse("ambiguous_vua_candidates", detail=str(int(r["birth_n_candidates"])))
    elif dataset == "legion" and RULES["legion_dash_split"] and isinstance(muni, str) and _DASH.search(muni):
        out = _town_city(_link_dash(muni, unit, megye, idx), r, unit, idx)
    else:
        out = link_one(names, hu, unit, megye, idx)
        out = _town_city(out, r, unit, idx)
    before = out                                          # 1.1.0: a candidate the guards refuse leaves this refusal
    if land is None:                                      # 1.1.0: the border (S1) and the tiers of (f) (S2)
        out = _border_link(out, names, hu, unit, idx)
        if out["refusal"] == "not_found":
            hy = muni if dataset == "vua" and isinstance(muni, str) and _HYPHEN.search(muni) else None
            out = _tiers_110(names, hu, unit, megye, idx, hy) or out
    if out["sid"] is not None:
        sid = out["sid"]
        cw = county_words(text, backbone, idx.lookups)
        sub = idx.gz.at[sid, "mai_orszag"] == "Ukrajna"
        k = _norm(text)
        if out["tier"] == "border_unit":                  # 1.1.0: the cell may name the stated county too
            cw = cw - {megye}
        if cw and idx.megye_of[sid] not in cw:
            out = _refuse("county_words_disagree", sid, detail=",".join(sorted(cw)))
        elif region_disagrees(k, sub, idx.megye_of[sid], str(r.get("birth_jaras_match")) in DISTRICT_TIERS):
            out = _refuse("region_words_disagree", sid)
        if out["sid"] is None and before["sid"] is None:    # a 1.1.0 candidate refused by the guards: the queue
            out = before                                    # keeps the cross_county_unique row, not_found stays
    out["source_question"] = q
    return out

def region_disagrees(k: str, sub: bool, county, has_district: bool) -> bool:
    """A region word of the normalised cell *k* contradicts the settlement (*sub*: in today's Ukraine; *county*: its
    1910 county). With ``RULES["region_district"]`` (1.0.1) a cell whose own district string found a unit
    (*has_district*) is not refused — VÚA writes *Slovensko* loosely beside a Subcarpathian okres (*Loza, okr.
    Iršava, Slovensko*) — and *Podkarpatská Rus* is compatible with a settlement of Ung on either side of today's
    border (:data:`REGION_SUB_COUNTIES`)."""
    new = RULES["region_district"]
    if new and has_district:
        return False
    sub_ok = sub or (new and county in REGION_SUB_COUNTIES)
    return bool((_REGION_SUB.search(k) and not sub_ok) or (_REGION_SK.search(k) and sub))

def in_scope(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """The births this module links: a ``birth_jaras_id``, or a village records_geo_hu's C3 took off a chartered
    town with no járás around it (``birth_jaras_town_okres`` = ring, county only)."""

def add_birth_settlement_sk_columns(df: pd.DataFrame, bundle: dict, backbone: pd.DataFrame,
                                    dataset: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """``df`` with the ``birth_settlement_sk_*`` columns (*dataset* ``legion`` or ``vua``; the VÚA frame carries
    ``birth_raw``, ``birth_n_candidates``, ``birth_loc_uncertain``). Rows out of :func:`in_scope` stay ``<NA>``."""
    idx = bundle.get("_index") or Index(bundle["gazetteer"], bundle["forms"], backbone, bundle.get("parts"))
    bundle["_index"] = idx
    out = df.copy()
    scope = in_scope(out)
    res = {i: link_row(r, dataset, idx, backbone) for i, r in out[scope].to_dict("index").items()}
    col = lambda k: pd.Series({i: v[k] for i, v in res.items()}, dtype="object").reindex(out.index)
    sid = col("sid")
    gz = idx.gz
    out["birth_settlement_sk_id"] = sid
    out["birth_settlement_sk_name"] = sid.map(lambda s: gz.at[s, "majo_name"] if pd.notna(s) and pd.notna(
        gz.at[s, "majo_name"]) else (gz.at[s, "mai_nev"] if pd.notna(s) else pd.NA))
    out["birth_settlement_sk_name_1912"] = sid.map(lambda s: gz.at[s, "name_1912"] if pd.notna(s) else pd.NA)
    out["birth_settlement_sk_unit"] = sid.map(lambda s: gz.at[s, "unit_id"] if pd.notna(s) else pd.NA)
    out["birth_settlement_sk_match"] = col("tier")
    out["birth_settlement_sk_name_source"] = col("group")
    tier = col("tier")
    comp = {"accent_only": col("accent_only"), "source_question": col("source_question"),
            "mai_nev_only": col("group").eq("today"),
            "fuzzy": tier.isin(["fuzzy_unit", "fuzzy_county", "sound_near_unit"]),
            "partial_name": tier.isin(["prefix_unit", "hyphen_part"]) | col("partial").eq(True),
            "name_conflict": col("name_conflict"),
            "border": tier.eq("border_unit"),                                          # 1.1.0
            "sound": tier.isin(["sound_unit", "sound_county", "sound_near_unit"]),
            "hungarian_several": tier.eq("hungarian_in_unit")}
    linked = sid.notna()
    for c, v in comp.items():
        out[f"birth_settlement_sk_{c}"] = pd.array(v.where(linked, pd.NA).astype("object"), dtype="boolean")
    out["birth_settlement_sk_uncertain"] = pd.array(
        pd.concat([v.fillna(False).astype(bool) for v in comp.values()], axis=1).any(axis=1).where(linked, pd.NA)
        .astype("object"), dtype="boolean")
    out["birth_jaras_corrected"] = pd.array(col("moved").where(linked, pd.NA).astype("object"), dtype="boolean")
    out["birth_settlement_sk_refusal"] = col("refusal")
    out["birth_settlement_sk_id_refused"] = col("refused_sid")
    out["birth_settlement_sk_detail"] = col("detail")
    out["birth_settlement_sk_in_scope"] = scope
    return out

def correct_census_jaras_id(df: pd.DataFrame, census_hu: pd.DataFrame, prefix: str='birth') -> pd.DataFrame

The Slovak mirror of utils.parsing.birth_settlement.correct_census_okres_id (D-247; the author, 2026-11-18: "Try to mimic the Czech side as much as possible"). {prefix}_census_jaras_id, the key notebook 02 §4b merges census_hu_jaras_1910 on, is the link's unit ({prefix}_settlement_sk_unit) where the link moved the járás ({prefix}_jaras_corrected: inside the county, or across it on a border_unit link) and where no járás was stated but the link supplies one (a county-only birth); elsewhere it is {prefix}_jaras_id. The census unit of a járás or chartered town is the unit itself (D-19: no pooling, both members of a twin keep their own row); a unit the census frame lacks (census_hu["unit_id"]) has no key, as an okres outside the Czech crosswalk has none. The written key is kept in {prefix}_census_jaras_id_stated on every row with a stated unit; {prefix}_jaras_id is never changed. Idempotent: the stated key is re-read from {prefix}_jaras_id on every call. Counts go to attrs["census_key"].

def correct_census_jaras_id(df: pd.DataFrame, census_hu: pd.DataFrame, prefix: str = "birth") -> pd.DataFrame:
    """The Slovak mirror of :func:`utils.parsing.birth_settlement.correct_census_okres_id` (D-247; the author,
    2026-11-18: "Try to mimic the Czech side as much as possible"). ``{prefix}_census_jaras_id``, the key notebook 02
    §4b merges ``census_hu_jaras_1910`` on, is the link's unit (``{prefix}_settlement_sk_unit``) where the link moved
    the járás (``{prefix}_jaras_corrected``: inside the county, or across it on a ``border_unit`` link) and where no
    járás was stated but the link supplies one (a county-only birth); elsewhere it is ``{prefix}_jaras_id``. The
    census unit of a járás or chartered town is the unit itself (D-19: no pooling, both members of a twin keep their
    own row); a unit the census frame lacks (``census_hu["unit_id"]``) has no key, as an okres outside the Czech
    crosswalk has none. The written key is kept in ``{prefix}_census_jaras_id_stated`` on every row with a stated
    unit; ``{prefix}_jaras_id`` is never changed. Idempotent: the stated key is re-read from ``{prefix}_jaras_id`` on
    every call. Counts go to ``attrs["census_key"]``."""
    p = f"{prefix}_"
    units = set(census_hu["unit_id"].dropna().astype(str))

    def in_census(s: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
        s = s.astype("string")
        return s.where(s.isin(units).fillna(False).astype(bool), pd.NA).astype("string")

    out = df.copy()
    written = out[p + "jaras_id"].astype("string")
    link_unit = out[p + "settlement_sk_unit"].astype("string")
    stated, target = in_census(written), in_census(link_unit)
    corr = out[p + "jaras_corrected"].astype("boolean").fillna(False).astype(bool)
    unstated = (written.isna() & link_unit.notna()).astype(bool)
    take = corr | unstated
    out[p + "census_jaras_id_stated"] = stated
    out[p + "census_jaras_id"] = stated.where(~take, target).astype("string")
    match = (out[p + "settlement_sk_match"].astype("string") if p + "settlement_sk_match" in out.columns
             else pd.Series(pd.NA, index=out.index, dtype="string"))
    border = match.eq("border_unit").fillna(False).astype(bool)
    twin = (out[p + "jaras_twin"].notna().astype(bool) if p + "jaras_twin" in out.columns
            else pd.Series(False, index=out.index))
    changed = corr & (target.fillna("") != stated.fillna(""))
    out.attrs["census_key"] = {"jaras_corrected": int(corr.sum()),
                               "jaras_corrected_within_county": int((corr & ~border).sum()),
                               "jaras_corrected_border_unit": int((corr & border).sum()),
                               "census_key_changed": int(changed.sum()),
                               "corrected_same_census_unit": int((corr & ~changed).sum()),
                               "corrected_without_census_unit": int((corr & target.isna()).sum()),
                               "corrected_twin_member": int((corr & twin).sum()),
                               "unstated_jaras_from_link": int(unstated.sum()),
                               "unstated_jaras_with_census_unit": int((unstated & target.notna()).sum()),
                               "stated_outside_census": int((written.notna() & stated.isna()).sum())}
    return out

def slovak_passes(df: pd.DataFrame, backbone: pd.DataFrame, majo: pd.DataFrame, cz_names: set,
                  rgh=None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Notebook 02 §4's four Transleithanian passes for the birth role (*rgh* = records_geo_hu, or a module
    with its interface): district seat, village, twins, land."""
    if rgh is None:

def czech_placed_frames(root: Path = ROOT) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """The birth frames before the Slovak passes, read as notebook 02 §4 and birth_settlement read them.

    Legionnaires: ``data/interim/legionnaires_clean`` (the file notebook 02 §4 reads) through
    :func:`records_geo.add_place_standardization` and :func:`records_geo.resolve_prague_suburbs` (birth role).
    VÚA: re-parsed from the raw ``Místo narození`` exactly as :func:`birth_settlement.link_inputs` does
    (:func:`birth_settlement.parse_vua_raw`, :func:`birth_settlement.reparse_vua_births`) on
    ``data/interim/habsburg_clean``, which keeps ``birth_raw`` and the candidate counts. ``data/interim``, not
    ``data/final``: the Slovak columns of ``data/final`` were written by records_geo_hu 1.4.0 (2026-11-05), so
    they could neither show the 1.5.0 repairs nor be measured against them."""
    from utils.parsing import birth_settlement as bs
    from utils.parsing import records_geo as rg
    geo = root / "data" / "final" / "geo"
    districts = pd.read_parquet(geo / "districts_1910.parquet")
    settlements = pd.read_parquet(geo / "settlements_1910.parquet")
    sk_names = rg.settlement_name_set(pd.read_parquet(geo / "settlements_hu_1910.parquet"), cols=("obec_sk",))
    leg = pd.read_parquet(root / "data" / "interim" / "legionnaires_clean.parquet",
                          columns=["legion_id", "birth_municipality", "birth_okres"])
    leg = rg.add_place_standardization(leg, districts, settlements, prefix="birth", exclude_names=sk_names)
    leg = rg.resolve_prague_suburbs(leg, prefix="birth", districts=districts, settlements=settlements)
    habs = pd.read_parquet(root / "data" / "interim" / "habsburg_clean.parquet",
                           columns=["vua_id", "birth_date", "birth_year", "birth_year_only", "birth_municipality",
                                    "birth_okres", "birth_land"])
    raw = pd.read_csv(root / "data" / "raw" / "habsburg" / "habsburg_fallen.csv",
                      usecols=["vua_id", "Místo narození"], dtype=str)
    vua = bs.reparse_vua_births(habs, bs.parse_vua_raw(raw), districts, settlements, sk_names)
    return {"legion": leg, "vua": vua}

def link_frames(frames: dict, backbone: pd.DataFrame, majo: pd.DataFrame, bundle: dict, rgh=None) -> dict:
    """``{dataset: frame}`` after the Slovak passes and the settlement link."""
    from utils.parsing import records_geo as rg
    cz_names = rg.settlement_name_set(pd.read_parquet(ROOT / "data" / "final" / "geo" / "settlements_1910.parquet"))
    out = {}
    for d, f in frames.items():
        n = len(f)
        f = slovak_passes(f, backbone, majo, cz_names, rgh)
        f = add_birth_settlement_sk_columns(f, bundle, backbone, d)
        assert len(f) == n, f"{d}: the Slovak passes changed the row count"
        out[d] = f
    return out

def coverage(f: pd.DataFrame, gz: pd.DataFrame | None = None) -> dict:
    """Scope, links, uncertain, járás corrections, tiers, refusals of one linked frame. ``jaras_corrected`` counts
    the births linked into another unit than their own; a birth with no unit (``no_unit_linked``: a C3
    county-only village) is not among them. ``subcarpathian_links`` counts linked settlements of
    ``gazetteer.subcarpathian`` (*gz*), whatever the birth's land."""
    s = f[f["birth_settlement_sk_in_scope"]]
    linked = s["birth_settlement_sk_id"].notna()
    unc = s["birth_settlement_sk_uncertain"].fillna(False).astype(bool)
    sub = set(gz.loc[gz["subcarpathian"].astype(bool), "idtel"]) if gz is not None else None
    return {"rows": int(len(f)), "in_scope": int(len(s)), "linked": int(linked.sum()),
            "linked_share": round(float(linked.mean()), 4) if len(s) else None,
            "linked_certain": int((linked & ~unc).sum()), "uncertain": int(unc.sum()),
            "uncertain_components": {c: int(s[f"birth_settlement_sk_{c}"].fillna(False).astype(bool).sum())
                                     for c in UNCERTAINTY_COMPONENTS},
            "jaras_corrected": int(s["birth_jaras_corrected"].fillna(False).astype(bool).sum()),
            "no_unit_linked": int((linked & s["birth_jaras_id"].isna()).sum()),
            "by_tier": _vc(s["birth_settlement_sk_match"]), "by_name_source": _vc(s["birth_settlement_sk_name_source"]),
            "refused": int((~linked).sum()), "refusals": _vc(s["birth_settlement_sk_refusal"]),
            "subcarpathian_links": int(s.loc[linked, "birth_settlement_sk_id"].isin(sub).sum())
            if sub is not None else None,
            "refusal_carries_settlement": int(s.loc[~linked, "birth_settlement_sk_id"].notna().sum()),
            "scope_without_reason": int((~linked & s["birth_settlement_sk_refusal"].isna()).sum())}

def rulings_queue(runs: dict, gz: pd.DataFrame, idx: Index | None = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """The refusals the author can rule on (:data:`QUEUE_REASONS`): ``cross_county_unique`` moves,
    ``hungarian_name_disagrees`` and (1.0.3) ``county_fuzzy_ruling`` — the near name ``county_fuzzy_any`` would link in
    another unit of the county, a block for one ruling — one row per birth, with the refused candidate settlement;
    ``hungarian_name`` (a cross-county move, 1.0.1) says how the cell's Hungarian name bears on it
    (``hungarian_only`` / ``hungarian_corroborates`` / ``hungarian_names_another`` / ``hungarian_picks_namesake``, <NA>
    where the cell has none or it is not unique); ``detail`` is the refusal's detail as the link wrote it
    (``county_fuzzy_any`` names the rule). 1.0.3 (``queue_near``, with *idx*): ``near_candidate_idtel`` / ``_name`` —
    the one settlement of the assigned unit (else the county) a Slovak name of which ends or starts with the record's
    name (*Polhora*, okres Brezno: *Pohronská Polhora* beside the queued *Oravská Polhora*) — and ``candidate_km``, the
    candidate's distance from the assigned unit's settlements' centre."""
    g = gz.set_index("idtel")
    rows = []
    for d, f in runs.items():
        idc = "legion_id" if d == "legion" else "vua_id"
        q = f[f["birth_settlement_sk_refusal"].isin(QUEUE_REASONS)]
        for r in q.itertuples():
            c = r.birth_settlement_sk_id_refused
            rows.append({"dataset": d, "id": getattr(r, idc), "reason": r.birth_settlement_sk_refusal,
                         "raw": getattr(r, "birth_raw", pd.NA) if d == "vua" else pd.NA,
                         "municipality": r.birth_municipality, "okres": r.birth_okres,
                         "assigned_unit": r.birth_jaras_id, "assigned_megye": r.birth_megye_id,
                         "candidate_idtel": c, "candidate_name": g.at[c, "majo_name"] if pd.notna(g.at[c, "majo_name"])
                         else g.at[c, "mai_nev"], "candidate_name_1912": g.at[c, "name_1912"],
                         "candidate_unit": g.at[c, "unit_id"], "candidate_megye": g.at[c, "megye_id"],
                         "hungarian_name": (getattr(r, "birth_settlement_sk_detail", "") or pd.NA)
                         if r.birth_settlement_sk_refusal == "cross_county_unique" else pd.NA,
                         "detail": getattr(r, "birth_settlement_sk_detail", "") or pd.NA,
                         **(_near_columns(r, c, idx) if idx is not None and RULES["queue_near"] else {}),
                         "ruling": pd.NA})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def build(out_dir: Path = OUT, root: Path = ROOT, rgh=None, frames: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Gazetteer + links + report + rulings queue -> *out_dir* (``output/places_sk/``). Nothing in ``data/final``.
    *rgh* / *frames* may be passed (the measurement switches records_geo_hu's repairs and reuses the frames)."""
    from utils.parsing import lexikon_sk as lxs
    out_dir = Path(out_dir)
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    geo = root / "data" / "final" / "geo"
    backbone = pd.read_parquet(geo / "districts_hu_1910.parquet")
    majo = pd.read_parquet(geo / "settlements_hu_1910.parquet")
    parts = lxs.parse_parts_sk(SK_LEXIKON)
    earlier = lxs.parse_earlier_years(SK_LEXIKON)
    bundle = build_gazetteer_sk(backbone, majo, parts, earlier=earlier)
    runs = link_frames(frames if frames is not None else czech_placed_frames(root), backbone, majo, bundle, rgh)
    _write(bundle["gazetteer"], out_dir / "gazetteer_sk_1910")
    _write(bundle["forms"], out_dir / "gazetteer_sk_1910_names", csv=False)
    _write(bundle["majo_join"].drop(columns=["name_norm"], errors="ignore"), out_dir / "majo_gista_join")
    _write(parts, out_dir / "majo_parts_1910")
    _write(bundle["label_swaps"], out_dir / "majo_label_swaps")
    _write(bundle["mai_nev_swaps"], out_dir / "gista_mai_nev_swaps")
    _write(bundle["mai_orszag_overrides"], out_dir / "gista_mai_orszag_overrides")
    for d, f in runs.items():
        idc = "legion_id" if d == "legion" else "vua_id"
        keep = [idc, *[c for c in CONTEXT_COLUMNS if c in f.columns], *LINK_COLUMNS]
        f[f["birth_settlement_sk_in_scope"]][keep].to_parquet(out_dir / f"birth_settlement_sk_links_{d}.parquet",
                                                              index=False)
    q = rulings_queue(runs, bundle["gazetteer"], bundle.get("_index"))
    q.to_csv(out_dir / "birth_settlement_sk_rulings_queue.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8", lineterminator="\n")
    rep = birth_settlement_sk_report(runs, bundle)
    rep["rulings_queue_rows"] = int(len(q))
    (out_dir / "birth_settlement_sk_report.json").write_text(json.dumps(rep, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) + "\n",
                                                             encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    (out_dir / "birth_settlement_sk_report.md").write_text(report_md(rep), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    return {"runs": runs, "bundle": bundle, "report": rep}

def report_md(rep: dict) -> str

The report as Markdown (headline numbers only; the JSON holds every count).

Used only inside this module.

def report_md(rep: dict) -> str:
    """The report as Markdown (headline numbers only; the JSON holds every count)."""
    lines = [f"# Slovak birthplace -> 1910 settlement (birth_settlement_sk {rep['version']})", "",
             f"Gazetteer: {rep['gazetteer']['settlements']:,} settlements ({rep['gazetteer']['subcarpathian']:,} "
             f"Subcarpathian), {rep['gazetteer']['with_majo_name']:,} with a Majo name. Majo rows joined: "
             f"{rep['majo_join']['joined']:,} / {rep['majo_join']['majo_rows']:,}; parts table "
             f"{rep['parts']:,} rows.", "", "| dataset | in scope | linked | uncertain | járás corrected | refused |",
             "|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|"]
    for d, c in rep["coverage"].items():
        lines.append(f"| {d} | {c['in_scope']:,} | {c['linked']:,} ({c['linked_share']:.1%}) | {c['uncertain']:,} | "
                     f"{c['jaras_corrected']:,} | {c['refused']:,} |")
    for d, c in rep["coverage"].items():
        lines += ["", f"## {d}", "", "Tiers: " + ", ".join(f"{k} {v:,}" for k, v in c["by_tier"].items()),
                  "", "Refusals: " + ", ".join(f"{k} {v:,}" for k, v in c["refusals"].items())]
    lines += ["", "Majo join gaps: " + ", ".join(f"{k} {v}" for k, v in rep["majo_join"]["gaps"].items()),
              "", "Majo 1910.1 label swaps (1880–1900 rows against 1910.1): "
              + (", ".join(f"{r['obec_sk']} <-> {r['partner']}" for r in rep["label_swaps"]) or "none"), "",
              "MAI NEV and Majo's populations crosswise (side gista: its MAI NEV form dropped from the index): "
              + (", ".join(f"{r['idtel']} reads {r['mai_nev']}, Majo's population says {r['majo_name_by_population']}"
                           f" ({r['side']})" for r in rep.get("mai_nev_swaps", [])) or "none"), "",
              "GISta MAI ORSZAG overridden to Szlovákia (Majo-joined): "
              + (", ".join(f"{r['majo_name']} ({r['mai_orszag_gista'] or 'blank'})"
                           for r in rep.get("mai_orszag_overrides", [])) or "none"), ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)

def town_surround_check(runs: dict, candidates: dict, gz: pd.DataFrame, min_share: float, min_linked: int=0) -> dict

{town: {candidate, linked, share, by_unit, keep}}: where the linked village births of each town-named okres (birth_jaras_town_okres = ring) lie, legion and VÚA pooled; each frame carries birth_okres_town, the town unit the district string named (the measurement takes it from a run with C3 off). runs should be linked with every town county-only (records_geo_hu.TOWN_SURROUND = {}), so no assignment favours a unit; candidates = town_surrounding_jaras. keep = the candidate holds at least min_share of the linked births (records_geo_hu.TOWN_SURROUND_MIN_SHARE); a town with fewer than min_linked linked village births (records_geo_hu.TOWN_SURROUND_MIN_LINKED) keeps its candidate: so few decide nothing. A "village" birth linked to the town's own settlement is the town under a name C3 missed, not a village (1.0.2: 25 of Banská Štiavnica's 100 were Banská Štiavnica a Banská Belá): it is left out and counted in town_linked.
