def town_surround_check(runs: dict, candidates: dict, gz: pd.DataFrame, min_share: float,
                        min_linked: int = 0) -> dict:
    """``{town: {candidate, linked, share, by_unit, keep}}``: where the linked village births of each town-named
    okres (``birth_jaras_town_okres`` = ring) lie, legion and VÚA pooled; each frame carries ``birth_okres_town``,
    the town unit the district string named (the measurement takes it from a run with C3 off). *runs* should be
    linked with every
    town county-only (``records_geo_hu.TOWN_SURROUND = {}``), so no assignment favours a unit; *candidates* =
    :func:`town_surrounding_jaras`. ``keep`` = the candidate holds at least *min_share* of the linked births
    (``records_geo_hu.TOWN_SURROUND_MIN_SHARE``); a town with fewer than *min_linked* linked village births
    (``records_geo_hu.TOWN_SURROUND_MIN_LINKED``) keeps its candidate: so few decide nothing. A "village" birth
    linked to the town's own settlement is the town under a name C3 missed, not a village (1.0.2: 25 of Banská
    Štiavnica's 100 were *Banská Štiavnica a Banská Belá*): it is left out and counted in ``town_linked``."""
    unit_of = gz.set_index("idtel")["unit_id"]
    rows = []
    for f in runs.values():
        if "birth_jaras_town_okres" not in f.columns:
            continue
        ring = f[f["birth_jaras_town_okres"].astype("object").eq("ring").fillna(False).astype(bool)
                 & f["birth_settlement_sk_id"].notna()]
        rows.append(pd.DataFrame({"town": ring["birth_okres_town"] if "birth_okres_town" in ring else pd.NA,
                                  "unit": ring["birth_settlement_sk_id"].map(unit_of)}))
    pooled = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True) if rows else pd.DataFrame(columns=["town", "unit"])
    out = {}
    for town, cand in sorted(candidates.items()):
        g = pooled.loc[pooled["town"] == town, "unit"]
        own = int((g == town).sum())
        g = g[g != town]
        share = float((g == cand).mean()) if len(g) else None
        out[town] = {"candidate": cand, "linked": int(len(g)), "town_linked": own,
                     "share": None if share is None else round(share, 3),
                     "by_unit": {str(k): int(v) for k, v in g.value_counts().head(6).items()},
                     "keep": share is None or len(g) < min_linked or share >= min_share}
    return out

birth_settlement_sk.py — a Slovak or Subcarpathian birthplace -> one 1910 settlement (GISta ``IDTel1910``)
=======================================================================================================
The Transleithanian counterpart of :mod:`utils.parsing.birth_settlement` (Czech lands -> ``settlement_id``).
:mod:`utils.parsing.records_geo_hu` places a Slovak / Rusyn birth in a 1910 **járás** (or chartered town); this
module goes one level down, to the **settlement** of the 1910 Hungarian census, keyed by GISta Hungarorum's
``IDTel1910`` (the id of every 1910 settlement in ``8_MO_1865_1910_settlement.accdb``, exported to
``data/raw/census_hu/settlements_1910/`` by ``utils/reference_tools/places/export_gista_settlements.py``).

The gazetteer (:func:`build_gazetteer_sk`)
-----------------------------------------
One row per 1910 settlement of a unit of the Upper-Hungary backbone (:mod:`utils.parsing.districts_hu`), plus
every settlement today in Ukraine (Subcarpathia): its 1912 official (Hungarian) name, today's name and country
(``MAI NEV``, ``MAI ORSZAG``), járás and county, the 1900 gazetteer / census names and the 1904–14 official
names, the centre coordinates, the 1910 population and mother tongue. The Slovak name comes from Majo (2012)
(:mod:`utils.parsing.lexikon_sk`, ``settlements_hu_1910``), joined **inside the unit** on the Majo name and a
second, independent fact — the 1910 population, or the town's 1912 name — never on ``MAI NEV`` alone:
``MAI NEV`` is today's municipality, so it repeats across a merger (*Stupava* is also *Mást*), names a
Hungarian town for Komárno (*Komárom*), and twice reads *Bratislava*. Where a 1910 obec is today a part of
another obec, Majo's sub-part 1910.2 gives the part -> parent pair (:func:`lexikon_sk.parse_parts_sk`), and the
parent is what ``MAI NEV`` says.

The link (:func:`add_birth_settlement_sk_columns`)
------------------------------------------------
Every birth with a ``birth_jaras_id`` (after :func:`records_geo_hu.resolve_jaras_twins`), legionnaire or VÚA,
is linked or refused, never guessed:

(b) ``exact_unit``      the birth name (the Slovak forms of Majo, the backbone's town names, the 1912 name, the
                        1900 and 1904–14 variants, ``MAI NEV`` where no Majo name exists; Czech spellings of the
                        Slovak adjectives tried as variants) names exactly one settlement of the assigned unit;
(c) ``hungarian_*``     the VÚA cell's Hungarian parenthetical against 1912 names **and** variants **within the
                        county** (bare *Eperjes* is Prešov, but *Pozsonyeperjes* is the place meant);
(c') ``prefix_unit``     the name is the head of exactly one ``<name> nad/pod …`` settlement of the assigned unit
                        (*Stráže* in the Senica unit is *Stráže nad Myjavou*): linked, uncertain (two refuse);
(d) ``name_county``     the name is unique in another járás **of the same county**: linked, and
                        ``birth_jaras_corrected``. A unique name in another county is **refused**
                        (``cross_county_unique``) and written to the rulings queue — *Dobroč* was a Brezno obec in
                        1880 and a Lučenec one in 1910;
(b') ``town_city``      (1.0.2) a birth on a chartered town whose municipality *is* the town (records_geo_hu's
                        ``city`` role) links the town's one settlement when no form of it matched;
(e) ``fuzzy_unit``      no exact name anywhere (an exact namesake in another county refuses instead); one
                        settlement of the unit scores >= 85 and no other of the county does, a name merely
                        contained in another not counting (always uncertain); ``fuzzy_county`` the same over the
                        county for a birth with no unit (a C3 county-only village, 1.0.1) or with no near name
                        in its unit (1.0.2, moved; never a settlement today in Hungary). Then, with nothing
                        found, a VÚA / legion-bracket Hungarian name unique outside the county is refused
                        ``cross_county_unique`` and queued (1.0.1).
(f) 1.1.0, each uncertain, each read only where (b)–(e) found nothing (``not_found``) or, for the border, refused
    ``cross_county_unique``:
    ``border_unit``       the one settlement a name names outside the county, none inside it, links when its járás
                          shares a stretch of boundary with the stated one (GISta ``MO_JarasVaros``,
                          :func:`jaras_borders`); ``birth_jaras_corrected``. Never on a cell whose two names point to
                          two settlements (``hungarian_names_another``), never on a birth with no unit; the cell's
                          county words may name the stated county or the candidate's;
    ``sound_unit`` /      the record's name, or the cell's Hungarian name, on a coarse sound key (:func:`sound_key_sk`,
    ``sound_county``      :func:`sound_key_hu`: *cs* = č, *sz* = s, *gy* = ď, *y* = i …) names exactly one settlement
                          of the whole gazetteer, and it lies in the unit / the county;
    ``sound_near_unit``   the unit's one near name on the sound key (as ``fuzzy_unit``), none elsewhere in the county
                          and no containing competitor;
    ``hungarian_in_unit`` the cell's Hungarian name names several settlements of the county but one of the unit;
    ``hyphen_part``       a VÚA ``A-B`` where Majo's 1910.2 gives *B* as a part of *A* and *B* names one settlement
                          of the unit (of the county, for a birth with no unit: *Fiačice* of *Gôtoväny*). Two of
                          these tiers naming two settlements refuse (``ambiguous_in_county``).

Guards: county words left in a cell must corroborate the settlement's county; a cell naming another land is
refused (not on a bare *Halič*, a Novohrad járás, and never on ř/ů alone); a VÚA cell with more than one
``;``-separated candidate is refused (counted by the parse, not by ``?``); a match that holds only after
stripping accents is flagged uncertain (*Horná* is not *Horňa*). Every link carries a match tier and an
uncertainty flag; every refusal a reason and no settlement.

Nothing here writes ``data/final``: :func:`build` writes ``output/places_sk/``.

The census key (:func:`correct_census_jaras_id`, 1.2.0)
------------------------------------------------------
``birth_census_jaras_id`` is the key notebook 02 §4b merges ``census_hu_jaras_1910`` on: the link's unit where the
link moved the járás or supplied one to a county-only birth, ``birth_jaras_id`` elsewhere; the written key stays in
``birth_census_jaras_id_stated``. The Slovak mirror of the Czech D-247 (D-262).

Changelog
---------
1.2.0 (2026-11-18)  D-262, the author's ruling ("Try to mimic the Czech side as much as possible"): the HU census key
                    follows the link, as the Czech one does (D-247). :func:`correct_census_jaras_id` writes
                    ``birth_census_jaras_id`` (the link's unit where ``birth_jaras_corrected`` or where no járás was
                    stated and the link supplies one; else ``birth_jaras_id``; a unit outside ``census_hu_jaras_1910``
                    has none) and ``birth_census_jaras_id_stated`` (``birth_jaras_id``); ``birth_jaras_id`` is never
                    changed; idempotent. The link itself is unchanged.
1.1.0 (2026-11-18)  The author's rulings on the 1.0.3 queue (D-257, D-256 extended; ``output/places_sk/measure_sk_1.1.0.json``), five
                    switchable rules (:data:`RULES_110`; all off = 1.0.3). ``border_unit`` (S1, amends D-257's blanket
                    refusal): a ``cross_county_unique`` candidate in a járás bordering the stated one links, uncertain
                    (component ``border``), ``birth_jaras_corrected``; the county words of the cell may name the stated
                    county. ``sound_exact``, ``sound_near``, ``hungarian_in_unit``, ``hyphen_part`` (S2): the tiers of
                    (f) above, uncertain (components ``sound``, ``hungarian_several``; ``hyphen_part`` is
                    ``partial_name``). Not built, by ruling: a namesake beside the border, VÚA's head county.
1.0.3 (2026-11-18)  Integration round (records_geo_hu 1.5.3; ``output/places_sk/measure_sk_1.0.3.json``), ten switchable
                    rules (:data:`RULES`; all off and ``county_fuzzy_any`` on = 1.0.2). ``county_fuzzy_any`` ships **off**
                    (the author's ruling is pending) and ``county_fuzzy_queue`` refuses its pick ``county_fuzzy_ruling``
                    (detail ``county_fuzzy_any``) into the rulings queue. ``fuzzy_contained``: a settlement whose name holds
                    the record's with letters to spare and shares a word of five letters or more with it is a competitor
                    of the near name, not nothing (*Šutovce*: Dolné / Horné Šútovce against Súlovce) — refused
                    ``ambiguous_in_county``. ``fuzzy_adjective_only``: no near name for a name of adjective or positional
                    words only (*Horné*, *Spišský*). ``fuzzy_hungarian_guard``: a near-name link or queue the cell's
                    Hungarian name contradicts — it names one settlement outside the county — is refused
                    ``cross_county_unique`` (``hungarian_names_another``; *Malé Rátovce (Kis-Rát)*). ``mai_nev_joined``:
                    ``MAI NEV`` is a ``today`` form also of a Majo-joined settlement whose Majo name differs from it, when
                    the join is not ``part_parent_pop`` / ``town_1912``, the settlement not ``mai_nev_swapped``, and the
                    name no other settlement's Majo name or ``MAI NEV`` in the county (*Dubnica nad Váhom*, *Lopej*).
                    ``swap_crosswise``: a ``MAI NEV`` swap GISta made (``side`` gista) joins the two Majo rows crosswise on
                    the population (tier ``swap_pop``: *Plavecký Mikuláš* = Detrekőszentmiklós); ``saint_drop``: an
                    ``<adjective> Svätý/Sv. <name>`` record also reads ``<adjective> <name>``; ``lone_adjective``: a Majo
                    name that is a lone county adjective (*Spišská*, a truncated two-line name) is no name form;
                    ``swap_reciprocal``: :func:`mai_nev_swaps` keeps a row only when its partner's row names it back.
                    ``queue_near`` (the rulings queue only): each queued row carries the one settlement of the assigned
                    unit (else county) whose Slovak name ends or starts with the record's name, and the distance of
                    the candidate from the unit.
1.0.2 (2026-11-18)  Second clean-up (records_geo_hu 1.5.2: C3n, S2f; ``output/places_sk/measure_sk_1.0.2.json``), twelve
                    switchable rules (:data:`RULES`; all off = 1.0.1). ``town_city``: a birth records_geo_hu put on a
                    chartered town by its municipality links the town's one settlement when the name found nothing
                    (*Banská Štiavnica a Banská Belá*). :func:`town_surround_check` leaves out a "village" linked to
                    the town itself. ``hungarian_labels``: *dříve: též X*, *dříve X*, *díve:*, *dřive:* stripped.
                    ``mai_nev_swaps``: where GISta's ``MAI NEV`` and Majo's populations disagree crosswise, the
                    Hungarian names decide which source swapped (:func:`mai_nev_swaps`), and a ``MAI NEV`` GISta
                    swapped names nothing (*Plavecký Mikuláš* / *Peter*). ``orszag_override``: a Majo-joined
                    settlement is today in Slovakia (:func:`override_country`; 13 GISta values, logged).
                    ``prefix_heads``: ``prefix_unit`` only before *nad/pod/pri* or a double-name hyphen.
                    ``legion_dash_split``: *A - B* the whole first, then each piece by name (two refuse, one is
                    uncertain ``partial_name``). ``word_order``: *Štiavnica Banská*. ``county_adjective``: *Porúbka* =
                    the unit's *Liptovská Porúbka* (``prefix_unit``). ``hungarian_picks``: a Hungarian name picking one
                    of a name's namesakes outside the county is queued. ``county_fuzzy_any``: a birth with no near name
                    in its unit takes the county's one (``fuzzy_county``, moved, uncertain). ``name_conflict`` (a new
                    uncertainty component): a link resting on a Hungarian name whose Slovak name names one other
                    settlement of the county. ``fuzzy_county_frame``: never a settlement today in Hungary.
1.0.1 (2026-11-18)  Clean-up (records_geo_hu 1.5.1, lexikon_sk 1.3.0; ``output/places_sk/measure_sk_1.0.1.json``).
                    **Majo join**: ``part_parent_pop`` never takes a settlement when another one of the unit has the
                    Majo name as its ``MAI NEV``, and ``pop_unit`` never serves a Majo name that is a ``MAI NEV``
                    anywhere in the county — a name-versus-population conflict stays unjoined (*Malá Paka*,
                    *Fiľakovské Kľačany*, *Kostolné Moravce*); a Majo 1910.1 row whose population fits its
                    1880–1900 rows only after swapping with another obec of the county is a label swap
                    (:func:`majo_label_swaps`: *Andrejová* / *Ondrašovce*) and joins nothing. **prefix_unit**: before
                    the county search, a name that is the head of exactly one ``<name> nad/pod …`` settlement of the
                    assigned unit links it (uncertain, ``partial_name``); two refuse. A birth with no unit (a C3
                    county-only village) has ``birth_jaras_corrected`` <NA>, not True. Guards: a bare *Halič* /
                    *Stará Halič* is the district anywhere in Nógrád; a land word on the record's own municipality
                    (*Bukovina*, *Čechy*) or followed by ``?`` does not refuse; *Ukrajina* is today's country, not
                    Russia; *Solnohrad* beside a resolved district is Solivar's German name, not Salzburg. Legion
                    names split on brackets, ``/`` and ``=`` (head first, the pieces as alternatives and as
                    Hungarian names). ``sz`` / ``cs`` / ``zs`` fold in the compact key. The county-word lookups
                    and the S2 alias forms follow ``records_geo_hu.DISTRICT_STRING_REPAIRS``, the lookups cached on
                    the :class:`Index`. Subcarpathian links are counted from the settlement, not the land. A region
                    word refuses only a cell with no resolved district of its own, and *Podkarpatská Rus* accepts
                    a settlement of Ung (:func:`region_disagrees`). A VÚA (or legion bracket) Hungarian name unique
                    outside the county is refused ``cross_county_unique`` and queued, the queue's
                    ``hungarian_name`` saying whether it corroborates the Slovak name's candidate (*Čebovce* = *Csáb*);
                    the Hungarian name alone queues only when no fuzzy tier links. A C3 county-only village may
                    take the county's one near name (``fuzzy_county``, uncertain). A Hungarian name found in the
                    county but outside the unit refuses (``hungarian_name_disagrees``) when the Slovak name names one
                    other settlement of the county (*Lučenec (Gácz)*: the town, not Halič), or of anywhere when the
                    Hungarian match is accent- or digraph-only (*Širákov (Sirák)*: Hont, not Nógrád's Szirák).
1.0.0 (2026-11-17)  First version (records_geo_hu 1.5.0, lexikon_sk 1.2.0).
"""

#: 1.0.1's rules, each switchable (``measure_birth_settlement_sk.py`` turns them off one at a time; all off = the
#: 1.0.0 link). ``join_guards`` the Majo join's name-versus-population guards; ``label_swaps`` the 1880–1900
#: check on Majo's 1910.1 labels; ``prefix_unit`` the ``<name> nad/pod …`` tier; ``land_guards`` the another-land
#: exemptions (Nógrád Halič, own municipality, ``?``, Ukrajina, Solnohrad); ``legion_split`` the legion bracket
#: split; ``compact_digraphs`` the ``cs``/``zs``/``sz`` fold of the compact key; ``region_district`` a region word
#: (*Podkarpatská Rus*, *Slovensko*) refuses only a cell whose own district string resolved no unit, and
#: *Podkarpatská Rus* never refuses a settlement of Ung (:data:`REGION_SUB_COUNTIES`); ``hungarian_queue`` a
#: Hungarian name unique outside the county is refused ``cross_county_unique`` (so queued for a ruling, never linked)
#: and the queue says whether it corroborates the Slovak name's candidate.
#: ``county_fuzzy`` a birth with no unit (a C3 county-only village) may take the county's one near name
#: (tier ``fuzzy_county``, uncertain), as a birth with a unit takes its unit's; ``hungarian_agrees`` a Hungarian
#: name found outside the unit does not link when the record's Slovak name (Majo / backbone forms) names one other
#: settlement of the county, or of anywhere when the Hungarian match holds only without accents or digraphs.
#:
#: 1.0.2's rules (all off = the 1.0.1 link): ``town_city`` a birth records_geo_hu put on a chartered town by its
#: municipality (role ``city``) whose name is no form of the town's one settlement (*Banská Štiavnica a Banská
#: Belá*) links that settlement (tier ``town_city``); ``hungarian_labels`` a label run (*dříve:*, *dříve též*,
#: *díve:*, *dřive:*) is stripped from a Hungarian name with or without its colon; ``mai_nev_swaps`` a settlement
#: whose ``MAI NEV`` GISta swapped with a neighbour's (:func:`mai_nev_swaps`) answers to no ``MAI NEV`` form;
#: ``orszag_override`` a settlement joined to Majo (present-day Slovakia only) is ``MAI ORSZAG`` *Szlovákia*
#: whatever GISta says (:func:`override_country`); ``prefix_heads`` ``prefix_unit`` takes only the head of a ``<name>
#: nad/pod/pri …`` settlement or of a double-name obec (*Zárieč - Keblov*), not any first word (*Dovhé* is not
#: *Dovhe Pole*); ``legion_dash_split`` a legion municipality splits on a spaced hyphen too (*Ersekujvar - Nové
#: Zámky*); ``word_order`` a two-word name written noun first is also read adjective first (*Štiavnica Banská*);
#: ``county_adjective`` ``prefix_unit`` also takes the one ``<county adjective> <name>`` settlement of the unit
#: (*Porúbka* in the Liptovský Mikuláš unit is *Liptovská Porúbka*); ``hungarian_picks`` a Hungarian name that
#: picks one of a name's namesakes outside the county queues that pick (``cross_county_unique``) instead of
#: refusing it unexplained; ``county_fuzzy_any`` a birth whose unit has no near name takes the county's one near
#: name (``fuzzy_county``, moved, uncertain); ``name_conflict`` a link resting on a Hungarian name is uncertain when
#: the record's Slovak name names exactly one other settlement of the county; ``fuzzy_county_frame`` ``fuzzy_county``
#: never takes a settlement today in Hungary.
#:
#: 1.0.3's rules (all off, and ``county_fuzzy_any`` on, = the 1.0.2 link): ``county_fuzzy_any`` ships **off** (an author
#: ruling) and ``county_fuzzy_queue`` refuses its pick ``county_fuzzy_ruling`` into the rulings queue; ``fuzzy_contained``

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Keys
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
_SOFT = re.compile(r"(?<=\w)[´'’`](?=\w)")
# Czech letters a Czech clerk writes for the Slovak ones, and Slovak letters a Czech clerk drops: folded in the
# accent-keeping key, so only a length or háček difference that remains marks a match "accent only".
_FOLD = str.maketrans({"ě": "e", "ř": "r", "ů": "u", "ľ": "l", "ĺ": "l", "ŕ": "r", "ä": "a", "ô": "o"})


def clean_name(s) -> str:
    """The raw name cell without soft-sign marks, ``?``, ``+``, brackets and a trailing comma."""
    if s is None or (not isinstance(s, str) and pd.isna(s)):
        return ""
    s = _SOFT.sub("", str(s))
    s = re.sub(r"[?+()\[\]]", " ", s)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip(" ,.;")


def key_plain(s) -> str:
    """De-accented key (:func:`records_geo._norm` of the cleaned name)."""
    return _norm(clean_name(s)).strip(" .")


def compact(plain: str) -> str:
    """A plain key made compact: no spaces, and the Hungarian digraphs folded to the de-accented Slovak letter —
    old ``cz`` and ``cs`` (č) to ``c``, ``zs`` (ž) to ``z``, ``sz`` to ``s`` (1.0.1: *Biksard* = *Bikszárd*)."""
    out = plain.replace(" ", "").replace("cz", "c")
    return out.replace("cs", "c").replace("zs", "z").replace("sz", "s") if RULES["compact_digraphs"] else out


def key_compact(s) -> str:
    """The plain key made :func:`compact` (*Nagy-Dobrony* = *Nagydobrony*, *Iloncza* = *Ilonca*): the last key
    tried, and a match on it counts as accent-only."""
    return compact(key_plain(s))


def key_acc(s) -> str:
    """Accent-keeping key: lower case, NFC, the Czech/Slovak letter pairs of :data:`_FOLD` folded, ``-`` a space."""
    t = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", clean_name(s)).lower().translate(_FOLD).replace("-", " ")
    return " ".join(t.split())


# sound_exact / sound_near (1.1.0): the Hungarian spellings read as the Slovak letters they write, in this order (``sz``
# parked so that the ``s`` -> ``š`` step leaves it alone), and the Slovak / Czech letters a clerk interchanges. Both keys
# then drop every accent and every space and hyphen, so *Szelincs* and *Selinč* meet on ``selinc``.
_HU_SOUND = (("ccs", "čč"), ("cs", "č"), ("cz", "c"), ("ch", "č"), ("zs", "ž"), ("sz", "\x01"), ("s", "š"),
             ("\x01", "s"), ("gy", "ď"), ("ny", "ň"), ("ly", "j"), ("ty", "ť"), ("ö", "e"), ("ő", "e"), ("ü", "u"),
             ("ű", "u"), ("y", "i"), ("w", "v"))
_SK_SOUND = (("y", "i"), ("ä", "e"), ("ô", "o"), ("ľ", "l"), ("ĺ", "l"), ("ŕ", "r"), ("ř", "r"), ("ů", "u"), ("ě", "e"),
             ("w", "v"))


def _strip_accents(s: str) -> str:
    return "".join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", s) if unicodedata.category(c) != "Mn")


def sound_key_hu(s) -> str:
    """1.1.0: a coarse sound key of a name spelt the Hungarian way (*cs*, *cz*, *ch* = č, *zs* = ž, *sz* = s, *s* = š,
    *gy* = ď, *ny* = ň, *ly* = j, *ty* = ť, *ö*/*ő* = e, *ü*/*ű* = u, *y* = i), accents, spaces and hyphens dropped."""
    t = clean_name(s).lower().replace("-", "").replace(" ", "")
    for a, b in _HU_SOUND:
        t = t.replace(a, b)
    return _strip_accents(t)


def sound_key_sk(s) -> str:
    """1.1.0: the same sound key for a name spelt the Slovak or Czech way (*y* = i, *ä* = e, *ô* = o, *ř* = r, *ů* = u,
    *ě* = e; *ch* stays *ch*), accents, spaces and hyphens dropped."""
    t = clean_name(s).lower().replace("-", "").replace(" ", "").replace("ch", "\x02")
    for a, b in _SK_SOUND:
        t = t.replace(a, b)
    return _strip_accents(t).replace("\x02", "ch")


# Czech forms of the Slovak positional adjectives, and the archaic -ia/-ie endings (Hornia, Dolnie).
_ADJ_VARIANTS = [
    (r"\bhorní\b", ("horný", "horná", "horné")), (r"\bdolní\b", ("dolný", "dolná", "dolné")),
    (r"\bvyšní\b", ("vyšný", "vyšná", "vyšné")), (r"\bnižní\b", ("nižný", "nižná", "nižné")),
    (r"\bstřední\b", ("stredný", "stredná", "stredné")), (r"\bhornia\b", ("horná",)), (r"\bdolnia\b", ("dolná",)),
    (r"\bvyšnia\b", ("vyšná",)), (r"\bnižnia\b", ("nižná",)), (r"\bhornie\b", ("horné",)), (r"\bdolnie\b", ("dolné",)),
    (r"\bvyšnie\b", ("vyšné",)), (r"\bnižnie\b", ("nižné",)), (r"\bstrednie\b", ("stredné",)),
    (r"\bvel(?:i)?ký\b", ("veľký",)), (r"\bvel(?:i)?ká\b", ("veľká",)), (r"\bvel(?:i)?ké\b", ("veľké",)),
    (r"\bsvatý\b", ("svätý",)), (r"\bnový\b", ("nový", "nová", "nové")),
]


def name_variants(s) -> list[str]:
    """The cleaned name and its Czech -> Slovak adjective variants (lower case, accents kept), original first."""
    base = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", clean_name(s)).lower()
    if not base:
        return []
    out = [base]
    w = base.split(" ")
    if RULES["word_order"] and len(w) == 2 and _ADJ_WORD.search(w[1]) and not _ADJ_WORD.search(w[0]):
        out.append(f"{w[1]} {w[0]}")                     # 1.0.2: Štiavnica Banská = Banská Štiavnica
    for pat, reps in _ADJ_VARIANTS:
        for v in list(out):
            if re.search(pat, v):
                out += [re.sub(pat, r, v) for r in reps]
    if RULES["saint_drop"]:                              # 1.0.3: Plavecký Svätý Mikuláš = Plavecký Mikuláš
        for v in list(out):
            m = _SAINT.match(v)
            if m and _ADJ_WORD.search(m.group(1)):
                out.append(f"{m.group(1)} {m.group(2)}")
    return list(dict.fromkeys(out))


# saint_drop (1.0.3): '<adjective> Svätý/Svätá/Svaté/Sv. <name>' (lower case, accents kept)
_SAINT = re.compile(r"^(\S+)\s+(?:sv[aä]t[ýáé]|sv\.?)\s+(.+)$")


# word_order (1.0.2): an adjective ending (Banská, Nová, Horný, Dolné, Veľké, Svätý; -í the Czech form, -ia/-ie old)
_ADJ_WORD = re.compile(r"(?:á|ý|é|í|ia|ie)$")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Gazetteer
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def load_gista(gista_dir: Path = GISTA_DIR) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """The exported GISta tables (every value a string), keyed by table name."""
    gista_dir = Path(gista_dir)
    man = json.loads((gista_dir / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return {t: pd.read_csv(gista_dir / v["file"], dtype=str, keep_default_na=False)
            for t, v in man["tables"].items()}


def unit_of_jaras(backbone: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, str]:
    """GISta ``IDJaras1910`` -> backbone ``unit_id``: identical, except a *tjv.* borough, which the backbone keys on
    its settlement id (``M1900`` -> ``M1900001`` Pozsony)."""
    return {u[:5]: u for u in backbone["unit_id"] if isinstance(u, str) and len(u) == 8}


def gista_settlements(gista: dict, backbone: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """One row per GISta 1910 settlement: ids, names, unit, county, population, mother tongue, coordinates."""
    m = gista["MAI_NEV_ES_ORSZAG"].rename(columns={
        "IDTel1910": "idtel", "telepulesnev_eredeti_1912": "name_1912", "IDJaras1910": "jaras_gista",
        "Jaras_1910": "jaras_hu", "IDMegye1910": "megye_id", "Megye_1910": "megye_hu", "MAI NEV": "mai_nev",
        "MAI ORSZAG": "mai_orszag", "Megyeszekhely": "megye_seat", "Jarasszekhely": "jaras_seat"})
    tjv = unit_of_jaras(backbone)
    m["unit_id"] = m["jaras_gista"].map(lambda j: tjv.get(j, j))
    e = gista["MO_1910_TER_LAK_ETN_telepulesek"].rename(columns={"id_tel_1910": "idtel", "jelen_nep": "pop_1910"})
    e = e[["idtel", "pop_1910", *TONGUES]].rename(columns=TONGUES)
    c = gista["MO_COORDINATES_settlement_CENTER"].rename(
        columns={"IDTel1910": "idtel", "FirstGeogr": "lon", "SecondGeog": "lat"})[["idtel", "lon", "lat"]]
    n = len(m)
    m = m.merge(e, on="idtel", how="left", validate="1:1").merge(c, on="idtel", how="left", validate="1:1")
    assert len(m) == n, "a GISta table join changed the settlement count"
    for col in ["pop_1910", *TONGUES.values(), "lon", "lat"]:
        m[col] = pd.to_numeric(m[col].replace("", np.nan), errors="coerce")
    m["in_backbone"] = m["unit_id"].isin(set(backbone["unit_id"]))
    return m


def gista_variants(gista: dict) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Long table ``idtel, form, source`` of the 1904–14 official names and the 1900 gazetteer and census names."""
    v = gista["MO_1900_nevvarians"]
    v = v.set_axis(["idtel", "bm1904", "jaras_bm", "hnt1900", "nep1900"], axis=1)
    long = v.melt(id_vars="idtel", value_vars=["bm1904", "hnt1900", "nep1900"], var_name="source", value_name="form")
    long = long[long["form"].str.strip() != ""]
    return long.drop_duplicates(["idtel", "form", "source"]).reset_index(drop=True)


def unit_country_shares(settlements: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Unit x today's country, the share of the unit's 1910 population (``MAI ORSZAG`` weighted by ``pop_1910``)."""
    t = settlements.pivot_table(index="unit_id", columns="mai_orszag", values="pop_1910", aggfunc="sum",
                                fill_value=0)
    return t.div(t.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan), axis=0).fillna(0)


def subcarpathian_units(settlements: pd.DataFrame, backbone: pd.DataFrame) -> frozenset[str]:
    """Backbone units most of whose 1910 population lives in today's Ukraine (``records_geo_hu.SUBCARPATHIAN_UNITS``)."""
    sh = unit_country_shares(settlements[settlements["in_backbone"]])
    ua = sh["Ukrajna"] if "Ukrajna" in sh.columns else pd.Series(0.0, index=sh.index)
    return frozenset(ua[ua > 0.5].index) & frozenset(backbone["unit_id"])


def town_surrounding_jaras(settlements: pd.DataFrame, backbone: pd.DataFrame,
                           twins: set | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
    """``{chartered town: the járás around it}`` for every town of the backbone not in *twins*
    (``records_geo_hu.TOWN_SURROUND``): the járás of the county named after the town (``jaras_hu`` = the town's
    Hungarian name + ``i``), else the járás holding >= :data:`NEAREST_MAJORITY` of the :data:`NEAREST_K` nearest
    settlements of the county (GISta centre coordinates). A town with neither is left out."""
    twins = twins or set()
    jar = backbone[backbone["unit_type"] == "járás"]
    out: dict[str, str] = {}
    for _, t in backbone[backbone["unit_type"] != "járás"].iterrows():
        if t["unit_id"] in twins:
            continue
        named = jar[(jar["megye_id"] == t["megye_id"]) & (jar["jaras_hu"].map(_norm) == _norm(f"{t['name_hu']}i"))]
        if len(named) == 1:
            out[t["unit_id"]] = named.iloc[0]["unit_id"]
            continue
        own = settlements[settlements["unit_id"] == t["unit_id"]].dropna(subset=["lat", "lon"])
        if own.empty:
            continue
        lat, lon = own["lat"].mean(), own["lon"].mean()
        cand = settlements[settlements["unit_id"].isin(set(jar.loc[jar["megye_id"] == t["megye_id"], "unit_id"]))]
        cand = cand.dropna(subset=["lat", "lon"])
        d = np.hypot((cand["lon"] - lon) * np.cos(np.radians(lat)), cand["lat"] - lat)
        vc = cand.loc[d.nsmallest(NEAREST_K).index, "unit_id"].value_counts()
        if len(vc) and vc.iloc[0] >= NEAREST_MAJORITY:
            out[t["unit_id"]] = vc.index[0]
    return out


def mai_nev_swaps(scope: pd.DataFrame, mj: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """1.0.2: settlements of one unit whose GISta ``MAI NEV`` and Majo's 1910 population disagree crosswise: Majo *X*
    is unjoined, *X* is the ``MAI NEV`` of settlement *A* and *X*'s 1910 population that of settlement *B*, while
    *B*'s ``MAI NEV`` is the unjoined Majo name *Y* whose population is *A*'s. One of the two sources has swapped
    the pair, and the Hungarian names say which (``side``): ``gista`` when **each** settlement's 1912 and 1900–14
    names are closer to the other one's ``MAI NEV`` than to its own (:func:`_closer_to_partner`: *Detrekőszentmiklós*
    999 reads *Plavecký Peter*, Majo's *Plavecký Mikuláš* has 999), else ``majo`` (*Kispaka* reads *Malá Paka*, as
    its name says: Majo's populations are the swapped side, as at *Seč*, *Kalná*, *Peťovka*). *mj* =
    :func:`join_majo`'s output. Returns ``idtel, mai_nev, majo_name_by_population, partner, side``, one row per
    settlement (*B*) of a pair."""
    cols = ["idtel", "mai_nev", "majo_name_by_population", "partner", "side"]
    g = scope[["idtel", "unit_id", "mai_nev", "pop_1910"]].assign(k=scope["mai_nev"].map(key_plain))
    m = mj.assign(k=mj["obec_sk"].map(key_plain), p=pd.to_numeric(mj["pop_total"], errors="coerce"))
    hu = scope.set_index("idtel")[[c for c in ("name_1912", "variants_1900_1914") if c in scope.columns]]
    rows = []
    for u, d in g.groupby("unit_id"):
        mu = m[m["unit_id"] == u]
        for x in mu[mu["idtel"].isna()].itertuples():
            a, b = d[d["k"] == x.k], d[d["pop_1910"] == x.p]
            if len(a) != 1 or len(b) != 1 or a.iloc[0]["idtel"] == b.iloc[0]["idtel"]:
                continue
            y = mu[(mu["k"] == b.iloc[0]["k"]) & (mu["p"] == a.iloc[0]["pop_1910"]) & mu["idtel"].isna()]
            if len(y) == 1:
                ia, ib = a.iloc[0]["idtel"], b.iloc[0]["idtel"]
                side = "gista" if _closer_to_partner(hu, ia, ib, g) and _closer_to_partner(hu, ib, ia, g) else "majo"
                rows += [(ib, b.iloc[0]["mai_nev"], x.obec_sk, ia, side)]
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=cols).drop_duplicates("idtel").reset_index(drop=True)
    if RULES["swap_reciprocal"]:                        # 1.0.3: a pair only when each row names the other back
        back = dict(zip(out["idtel"], out["partner"]))
        out = out[[back.get(q) == i for i, q in zip(out["idtel"], out["partner"])]].reset_index(drop=True)
    return out


def join_swaps(mj: pd.DataFrame, swaps: pd.DataFrame, scope: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """1.0.3 (``swap_crosswise``): for each settlement of a ``MAI NEV`` swap GISta made (``side`` gista), the unjoined
    Majo row of its unit whose name is the settlement's ``majo_name_by_population`` and whose 1910 population is the
    settlement's joins it, tier ``swap_pop`` (*Plavecký Mikuláš* 999 = Detrekőszentmiklós 999, whose ``MAI NEV`` reads
    *Plavecký Peter*). One row each side, else nothing. *mj* = :func:`join_majo`'s output (returned updated)."""
    mj = mj.copy()
    if swaps is None or swaps.empty:
        return mj
    g = scope.set_index("idtel")
    used = set(mj["idtel"].dropna())
    for r in swaps[swaps["side"] == "gista"].itertuples():
        if r.idtel in used or r.idtel not in g.index:
            continue
        pop = g.at[r.idtel, "pop_1910"]
        hit = mj[mj["idtel"].isna() & (mj["unit_id"] == g.at[r.idtel, "unit_id"])
                 & (mj["obec_sk"].map(key_plain) == key_plain(r.majo_name_by_population))
                 & (pd.to_numeric(mj["pop_total"], errors="coerce") == pop)]
        if len(hit) == 1:
            mj.loc[hit.index, ["idtel", "majo_join", "majo_gap"]] = [r.idtel, "swap_pop", pd.NA]
            used.add(r.idtel)
    return mj


# Hungarian positional qualifiers read as the Slovak stems they translate (Felső- = Horná, Kis- = Malá ...), and the
# Slovak adjective endings dropped, so *Felsőszecse* meets *Horná Seč* (mai_nev_swaps' side test only)
_HU_QUAL = [(r"felso", " horn "), (r"also", " doln "), (r"^kis", " mal "), (r"^nagy", " velk ")]
_SK_QUAL = re.compile(r"(horn|doln|mal|velk|vysn|nizn)[aye]")


def _closer_to_partner(hu: pd.DataFrame, i: str, j: str, g: pd.DataFrame) -> bool:
    """The Hungarian names of settlement *i* score higher (rapidfuzz partial ratio) against the words of *j*'s
    ``MAI NEV`` that *i*'s lacks than against the words of *i*'s own that *j*'s lacks."""
    def sk(n):
        return _SK_QUAL.sub(r"", _norm(n)).split()
    mai = g.set_index("idtel")["mai_nev"]
    own, other = sk(mai[i]), sk(mai[j])
    t_own, t_other = " ".join(w for w in own if w not in other), " ".join(w for w in other if w not in own)
    names = [hu.at[i, "name_1912"], *str(hu.at[i, "variants_1900_1914"] if "variants_1900_1914" in hu.columns
                                         and pd.notna(hu.at[i, "variants_1900_1914"]) else "").split("; ")]
    keys = []
    for n in names:
        k = _norm(n).replace(" ", "")
        for pat, rep in _HU_QUAL:
            k = re.sub(pat, rep, k)
        keys += [" ".join(k.split())] if k.strip() else []
    if not keys or not t_own or not t_other:
        return False
    return max(fuzz.partial_ratio(t_other, k) for k in keys) > max(fuzz.partial_ratio(t_own, k) for k in keys)


def override_country(scope: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """1.0.2: ``MAI ORSZAG`` *Szlovákia* on every settlement joined to Majo (which covers present-day Slovakia only),
    except a ``town_1912`` join, the one tier that does not rest on a Slovak name (*Komárom* is in Hungary today, and
    Komárno is its Slovak half). GISta's own value stays in ``mai_orszag_gista``. Returns the overridden rows
    (``idtel, name_1912, majo_name, mai_orszag_gista``); *scope* is changed in place."""
    scope["mai_orszag_gista"] = scope["mai_orszag"]
    hit = scope["majo_name"].notna() & scope["majo_join"].ne("town_1912") & scope["mai_orszag"].ne("Szlovákia")
    over = scope.loc[hit, ["idtel", "name_1912", "majo_name", "mai_orszag_gista"]].reset_index(drop=True)
    if RULES["orszag_override"]:
        scope.loc[hit, "mai_orszag"] = "Szlovákia"
    return over


def town_other_names(settlements: pd.DataFrame, backbone: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, tuple[str, ...]]:
    """``{town unit: (MAI NEV,)}`` for every chartered town of the backbone whose one settlement lies in today's
    Slovakia and whose ``MAI NEV`` is none of the town's backbone names (``records_geo_hu.TOWN_OTHER_NAMES``:
    *Selmec- és Bélabánya* -> *Banská Belá*, the other half of the joined 1910 town; *Breznóbánya* -> *Brezno*)."""
    out = {}
    for _, t in backbone[backbone["unit_type"] != "járás"].iterrows():
        own = settlements[(settlements["unit_id"] == t["unit_id"]) & (settlements["mai_orszag"] == "Szlovákia")]
        names = {_norm(t.get(c)) for c in ("name_sk", "name_sk_alt", "name_sk_modern", "name_hu")}
        if len(own) == 1 and _norm(own.iloc[0]["mai_nev"]) not in names:
            out[t["unit_id"]] = (own.iloc[0]["mai_nev"],)
    return out


def borders_from_rings(unit_ids: list, polygons: list, grid: float = BORDER_GRID_M,
                       min_shared: int = BORDER_MIN_SHARED) -> dict[str, frozenset]:
    """1.1.0 (``border_unit``): ``{unit: the units whose polygon shares a stretch of boundary with it}``. Every ring
    vertex is snapped to a *grid* (metres, the projected coordinates of the shapefile); two units border when at least
    *min_shared* snapped vertices are theirs both — a shared edge, not a corner point. *polygons* =
    :func:`utils.parsing.spatial.read_polygons` (one list of ``(N, 2)`` rings per unit, in *unit_ids*' order)."""
    owner: dict[tuple, set] = {}
    for uid, rings in zip(unit_ids, polygons):
        for ring in rings:
            for x, y in np.round(np.asarray(ring, dtype=float) / grid).astype(np.int64):
                owner.setdefault((int(x), int(y)), set()).add(uid)
    shared: Counter = Counter()
    for units in owner.values():
        if len(units) > 1:
            shared.update(combinations(sorted(units), 2))
    out: dict[str, set] = {}
    for (a, b), n in shared.items():
        if n >= min_shared:
            out.setdefault(a, set()).add(b)
            out.setdefault(b, set()).add(a)
    return {u: frozenset(v) for u, v in out.items()}


_BORDERS: dict[str, dict] = {}


def jaras_borders(shp_path: Path = JARAS_SHP) -> dict[str, frozenset]:
    """1.1.0: :func:`borders_from_rings` over GISta Hungarorum's 1910 ``MO_JarasVaros`` (its ``IDJaras`` is the backbone's
    ``unit_id``: a *tjv.* borough keyed on its settlement), read once per path; ``{}`` when the shapefile is absent
    (``border_unit`` then links nothing)."""
    shp_path = Path(shp_path)
    if str(shp_path) not in _BORDERS:
        if not shp_path.exists():
            return {}
        from utils.parsing.districts import read_dbf
        from utils.parsing.spatial import read_polygons
        ids = [r["IDJaras"] for r in read_dbf(shp_path.with_suffix(".dbf"), encodings=("utf-8", "cp1250", "latin-1"))]
        _BORDERS[str(shp_path)] = borders_from_rings(ids, read_polygons(shp_path))
    return _BORDERS[str(shp_path)]


def gazetteer_scope(settlements: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """The settlements the link searches: every settlement of a backbone unit, plus every one in today's Ukraine."""
    return settlements[settlements["in_backbone"] | (settlements["mai_orszag"] == "Ukrajna")].copy()


def _parent_keys(parts: pd.DataFrame | None) -> dict[tuple[str, int], set[str]]:
    """``{(part key, 1910 population): {parent keys}}`` from Majo's 1910.2 parts (lexikon_sk.parse_parts_sk)."""
    out: dict[tuple[str, int], set[str]] = {}
    if parts is None or parts.empty:
        return out
    for p, par, pop in zip(parts["part_sk"], parts["parent_sk"], parts["pop_total"]):
        if pd.notna(pop):
            out.setdefault((key_plain(p), int(pop)), set()).add(key_plain(par))
    return out


def _claim(pairs: list[tuple[int, str]], tier: str, joined: dict, used: set) -> None:
    """Accept *pairs* (Majo row, idtel) where both sides are unique within *pairs* and still free."""
    if not pairs:
        return
    rows = pd.Series([r for r, _ in pairs]).value_counts()
    ids = pd.Series([i for _, i in pairs]).value_counts()
    for r, i in pairs:
        if rows[r] == 1 and ids[i] == 1 and r not in joined and i not in used:
            joined[r] = (i, tier)
            used.add(i)


def _join_steps(parent: dict, town_hu: dict, used: set, majo_keys: dict, county_keys: dict,
                named_ok: set) -> dict:
    """The per-unit candidate pickers of :func:`join_majo`, in order. A name-versus-population conflict joins
    nothing — neither side decides (*Klíž*: GISta's ``MAI NEV`` can be the wrong one too): ``part_parent_pop``
    never takes a settlement when another settlement of the unit has the Majo name as its ``MAI NEV``
    (*Malá Paka* 322 is not *Nagypaka* while *Kispaka* is today's Malá Paka); ``pop_unit`` never takes a
    settlement whose ``MAI NEV`` is another Majo name of the unit, nor serves a Majo name that is a ``MAI NEV``
    anywhere in the county (1.0.1; was: in the unit — *Ondrašovce* 401 is not *Endrevágása* while
    *Andrásvágás* of the next unit is today's Ondrašovce), unless that settlement already joined a Majo row of
    the name on name and population (a namesake: *Matejovce* of Spišská Nová Ves is *Hernádmáté* while the
    Poprad *Matejovce* is *Mateóc*). *county_keys* = ``{county: {MAI NEV key: {idtel}}}``; *named_ok* = the
    settlements ``name_pop`` joined (filled by :func:`join_majo` after that tier)."""
    def empty(d):
        return d.iloc[0:0]

    def part_parent(r, d):
        if pd.isna(r.pop):
            return empty(d)
        c = d[d["k"].isin(parent.get((r.k, int(r.pop)), set())) & (d["pop_1910"] == r.pop)]
        named = set(d.loc[d["k"] == r.k, "idtel"]) if RULES["join_guards"] else set()
        return empty(d) if named - set(c["idtel"]) else c

    def pop_unit(r, d):
        clash = county_keys.get(r.megye, {}).get(r.k, set()) - named_ok if RULES["join_guards"] else set()
        if pd.isna(r.pop) or clash or (d["k"] == r.k).any():
            return empty(d)
        return d[(d["pop_1910"] == r.pop) & ~d["idtel"].isin(used) & ~d["k"].isin(majo_keys.get(r.unit_id, set()))]
    return {
        "name_pop": lambda r, d: d[(d["k"] == r.k) & (d["pop_1910"] == r.pop)],
        "part_parent_pop": part_parent,
        "town_1912": lambda r, d: (d if (r.unit_type == "town" and len(d) == 1
                                         and _norm(d.iloc[0]["name_1912"]) == town_hu.get(r.unit_id))
                                   else empty(d)),
        "pop_unit": pop_unit,
    }


def join_majo(scope: pd.DataFrame, majo: pd.DataFrame, parts: pd.DataFrame | None,
              backbone: pd.DataFrame, swaps: pd.DataFrame | None = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Majo rows -> GISta ``idtel``, one to one, each pair resting on the name **and** a second fact.

    Tiers, in order (a Majo row or a settlement taken by an earlier tier is not offered again):
    ``name_pop`` same unit, Majo name = ``MAI NEV``, equal 1910 population; ``part_parent_pop`` same unit, the
    Majo obec is a *part* whose today's parent is the ``MAI NEV``, equal population; ``town_1912`` a Majo town
    row and the one settlement of its town unit, whose 1912 name is the backbone's Hungarian name of the town
    (Komárno = *Komárom*); ``pop_unit`` same unit, the one free settlement of that population (``MAI NEV``
    swapped between two neighbours: *Plavecký Mikuláš* / *Plavecký Peter*); ``name_pop_any_unit`` a Majo row
    with no unit (Žitný ostrov, Cserhát …), name and population equal anywhere in scope. ``MAI NEV`` alone never
    joins, nor a name-versus-population conflict (:func:`_join_steps`), nor a Majo row of *swaps*
    (:func:`majo_label_swaps`) on a tier that rests on the population alone (``part_parent_pop``, ``pop_unit``):
    where the name joins too, GISta confirms the 1910 label (*Setechov*, *Lietavská Lúčka*: the disagreement
    lies in Majo's earlier rows), and a town joins on its 1912 name (*Banská Štiavnica* / *Krupina*: Majo's
    1910.1 figures are swapped, the names are not — ``majo_pop`` is then not the town's). Returns *majo* with ``majo_row``, ``idtel``, ``majo_join`` (``<NA>`` +
    ``majo_gap`` where unjoined) and ``majo_label_swap``.
    """
    mj = majo.reset_index(drop=True).copy()
    mj["majo_row"] = mj.index
    mj["k"] = mj["obec_sk"].map(key_plain)
    mj["pop"] = pd.to_numeric(mj["pop_total"], errors="coerce")
    mj["majo_label_swap"] = _swap_flags(mj, swaps)
    g = scope[["idtel", "unit_id", "megye_id", "name_1912", "mai_nev", "pop_1910"]].copy()
    g["k"] = g["mai_nev"].map(key_plain)
    by_unit = {u: d for u, d in g.groupby("unit_id")}
    mj["megye"] = mj["unit_id"].map(g.drop_duplicates("unit_id").set_index("unit_id")["megye_id"])
    county_keys: dict[str, dict[str, set]] = {}
    for m, k, i in zip(g["megye_id"], g["k"], g["idtel"]):
        county_keys.setdefault(m, {}).setdefault(k, set()).add(i)
    town_hu = {r["unit_id"]: _norm(r["name_hu"]) for _, r in backbone.iterrows() if r["unit_type"] != "járás"}
    joined: dict[int, tuple[str, str]] = {}
    used: set[str] = set()
    majo_keys = mj.groupby("unit_id")["k"].agg(set).to_dict()
    free, named_ok = mj[~mj["majo_label_swap"]], set()
    for tier, pick in _join_steps(_parent_keys(parts), town_hu, used, majo_keys, county_keys, named_ok).items():
        pairs = []
        rows = free if tier in ("part_parent_pop", "pop_unit") else mj
        for r in rows[rows["unit_id"].notna()].itertuples():
            if r.majo_row not in joined:
                pairs += [(r.majo_row, i) for i in pick(r, by_unit.get(r.unit_id, g.iloc[0:0]))["idtel"]]
        _claim(pairs, tier, joined, used)
        if tier == "name_pop":
            named_ok |= {i for i, t in joined.values() if t == "name_pop"}
    pairs = [(r.majo_row, i) for r in mj[mj["unit_id"].isna()].itertuples()
             for i in g.loc[(g["k"] == r.k) & (g["pop_1910"] == r.pop), "idtel"]]
    _claim(pairs, "name_pop_any_unit", joined, used)
    mj["idtel"] = mj["majo_row"].map(lambda r: joined[r][0] if r in joined else pd.NA)
    mj["majo_join"] = mj["majo_row"].map(lambda r: joined[r][1] if r in joined else pd.NA)
    mj["majo_gap"] = [_majo_gap(r, by_unit, county_keys) if pd.isna(r.idtel) else pd.NA for r in mj.itertuples()]
    return mj.drop(columns=["k", "pop", "megye"])


def _swap_flags(mj: pd.DataFrame, swaps: pd.DataFrame | None) -> pd.Series:
    """True on the Majo rows *swaps* names (same ``obec_sk``, ``okres_sk``, ``zupa_sk`` and 1910 population)."""
    if swaps is None or swaps.empty:
        return pd.Series(False, index=mj.index)
    key = ["obec_sk", "okres_sk", "zupa_sk", "pop_total"]
    flagged = set(map(tuple, swaps[key].astype(str).values))
    return pd.Series([tuple(x) in flagged for x in mj[key].astype(str).values], index=mj.index)


def _majo_gap(r, by_unit: dict, county_keys: dict) -> str:
    """Why a Majo row found no settlement (the report's gap list)."""
    if r.majo_label_swap:
        return "majo_label_swap"
    if pd.isna(r.unit_id):
        return "no_unit_and_no_name_population_match"
    d = by_unit.get(r.unit_id)
    if d is None:
        return "unit_has_no_gista_settlement"
    named = d[d["k"] == r.k]
    if len(named) == 1:
        return "mai_nev_alone_population_differs"     # never joined on MAI NEV alone
    if len(named) > 1:
        return "mai_nev_repeats_population_differs"
    if county_keys.get(r.megye, {}).get(r.k):
        return "mai_nev_in_county_population_differs"  # 1.0.1: a name-versus-population conflict
    return "name_not_in_unit_population_not_unique"


def _fits(a, b) -> bool:
    """*a* within :data:`SWAP_FIT_FACTOR` of *b* (both present, *b* positive)."""
    return pd.notna(a) and pd.notna(b) and b > 0 and 1 / SWAP_FIT_FACTOR <= a / b <= SWAP_FIT_FACTOR


def majo_label_swaps(majo: pd.DataFrame, earlier: pd.DataFrame | None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Majo 1910.1 rows whose names are swapped: an obec whose 1910 population is off the median of its own
    1880–1900 rows by :data:`SWAP_OFF_FACTOR` or more, where exactly one other such obec of the county fits — its
    1910 population within :data:`SWAP_FIT_FACTOR` of this one's earlier median, and the reverse (*Andrejová*
    386/389/379 then 136, *Ondrašovce* 134/156/152 then 401). *majo* = ``settlements_hu_1910``; *earlier* =
    :func:`lexikon_sk.parse_earlier_years`. A name the county holds twice in any year is not checked. Returns the
    flagged 1910.1 rows (``obec_sk, okres_sk, zupa_sk, pop_total``) with ``median_1880_1900`` and ``partner``."""
    cols = ["obec_sk", "okres_sk", "zupa_sk", "pop_total", "median_1880_1900", "partner"]
    if earlier is None or earlier.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=cols)

    def keyed(df):
        df = df[df["unit_type"].isin(["obec", "town"])]
        return df.assign(_z=df["zupa_sk"].map(_norm), _n=df["obec_sk"].map(key_plain))
    cur, old = keyed(majo), keyed(earlier)
    dup = set(map(tuple, cur.loc[cur.duplicated(["_z", "_n"], keep=False), ["_z", "_n"]].values)) | \
        set(map(tuple, old.loc[old.duplicated(["_z", "_n", "year"], keep=False), ["_z", "_n"]].values))
    med = old.groupby(["_z", "_n"])["pop_total"].median()
    cur = cur[[(z, n) not in dup for z, n in zip(cur["_z"], cur["_n"])]].copy()
    cur["median_1880_1900"] = [med.get((z, n)) for z, n in zip(cur["_z"], cur["_n"])]
    p, m = pd.to_numeric(cur["pop_total"], errors="coerce"), pd.to_numeric(cur["median_1880_1900"])
    off = cur[((p / m) >= SWAP_OFF_FACTOR) | ((m / p) >= SWAP_OFF_FACTOR)].copy()
    partner = {}
    for _, grp in off.groupby("_z"):
        for i, r in grp.iterrows():
            hits = [j for j, q in grp.iterrows() if j != i and _fits(r["pop_total"], q["median_1880_1900"])
                    and _fits(q["pop_total"], r["median_1880_1900"])]
            if len(hits) == 1:
                partner[i] = grp.at[hits[0], "obec_sk"]
    off["partner"] = off.index.map(partner)
    return off.loc[off["partner"].notna(), cols].reset_index(drop=True)


def _forms(gz: pd.DataFrame, variants: pd.DataFrame, backbone: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Long table ``idtel, form, source, key_acc, key_plain`` of every name a settlement answers to."""
    rows = [gz.loc[gz["majo_name"].notna(), ["idtel", "majo_name"]].set_axis(["idtel", "form"], axis=1)
            .assign(source="majo"),
            gz.loc[gz["majo_name"].isna(), ["idtel", "mai_nev"]].set_axis(["idtel", "form"], axis=1)
            .assign(source="mai_nev"),
            gz[["idtel", "name_1912"]].set_axis(["idtel", "form"], axis=1).assign(source="hu1912"),
            variants[variants["idtel"].isin(set(gz["idtel"]))][["idtel", "form", "source"]]]
    one = gz.groupby("unit_id")["idtel"].agg(list)
    seat = gz[gz["jaras_seat"].astype(str).eq("True")].groupby("unit_id")["idtel"].agg(list)
    for _, t in backbone.iterrows():
        # a chartered town is its one settlement; a járás is named after its seat (GISta Jarasszekhely), so the
        # backbone's Slovak names of the unit are names of that settlement (Turčiansky Svätý Martin = Martin)
        # (a járás's name_sk_alt is a district alias, not its seat: Šaľa for the Tornóc-seated Vágsellyei járás)
        town = t["unit_type"] != "járás"
        ids = one.get(t["unit_id"], []) if town else seat.get(t["unit_id"], [])
        cols = ("name_sk", "name_sk_alt", "name_sk_modern") if town else ("name_sk", "name_sk_modern")
        names = [t.get(c) for c in cols if isinstance(t.get(c), str)]
        if len(ids) == 1 and names:
            rows.append(pd.DataFrame({"idtel": ids[0], "form": names, "source": "backbone"}))
    # the old Slovak / interwar names records_geo_hu's alias table gives the seat towns (Frašták = Hlohovec, Parkan
    # = Štúrovo, Nižní Verecky = Alsóverecke): the alias keys are de-accented, so a match on them is accent-only
    from utils.parsing import records_geo_hu as rgh
    seats = getattr(rgh, "DISTRICT_ALIAS_SEATS", {}) if getattr(rgh, "DISTRICT_STRING_REPAIRS", False) else {}
    al = [(i, a) for a, i in seats.items() if i in set(gz["idtel"]) and not a.startswith(("tisahat", "tiszahat"))]
    if al:
        rows.append(pd.DataFrame(al, columns=["idtel", "form"]).assign(source="backbone"))
    if RULES["mai_nev_joined"]:                             # 1.0.3: the interwar name of a Majo-joined settlement
        rows.append(_joined_mai_nev(gz))
    f = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)
    f = f[f["form"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip() != ""].copy()
    if RULES["lone_adjective"]:                             # 1.0.3: Majo's truncated 'Spišská' names nothing
        f = f[~(f["source"].eq("majo") & f["form"].map(_lone_county_adjective))]
    f["key_acc"], f["key_plain"] = f["form"].map(key_acc), f["form"].map(key_plain)
    return f.drop_duplicates(["idtel", "key_acc", "source"]).reset_index(drop=True)


def _lone_county_adjective(form) -> bool:
    """1.0.3 (``lone_adjective``): *form* is one word and a county adjective (*Spišská*, *Liptovská*: records_geo_hu's
    county-adjective reader), the first line of a two-line Majo name, not an obec (*Nemecká*, *Valaská* are)."""
    k = key_plain(form)
    return bool(k) and " " not in k and _county_adjective_word(k)


def _joined_mai_nev(gz: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """1.0.3 (``mai_nev_joined``): ``idtel, form, source`` = ``mai_nev`` rows for the Majo-joined settlements whose
    ``MAI NEV`` is not their Majo name (*Máriatölgyes*: Majo joined it on the population as *Dubnica*; ``MAI NEV``
    *Dubnica nad Váhom*) — never a ``part_parent_pop`` join (``MAI NEV`` is then the merged parent: *Bošany*) or a
    ``town_1912`` one (*Komárom*), never a ``mai_nev_swapped`` settlement, never a respelling of the Majo name (a near
    name, :data:`FUZZY_CUTOFF`: *Trenčianske Teplice* beside Majo's *Trenčianska Teplice* would only crowd the near-name
    tier) or a name under :data:`MAI_NEV_MIN_LEN` letters (*Dlhá*), and only where no other settlement of the county
    has the name as its Majo name or its ``MAI NEV``."""
    cols = ["idtel", "form", "source"]
    need = {"majo_name", "majo_join", "mai_nev", "megye_id"}
    if not need <= set(gz.columns):
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=cols)
    k_mai, k_majo = gz["mai_nev"].map(key_plain), gz["majo_name"].map(key_plain)
    swapped = gz["mai_nev_swapped"].astype(bool) if "mai_nev_swapped" in gz.columns else False
    other = [bool(a) and bool(b) and fuzz.ratio(a, b) < FUZZY_CUTOFF for a, b in zip(k_mai, k_majo.fillna(""))]
    pick = (gz["majo_name"].notna() & ~gz["majo_join"].isin(["part_parent_pop", "town_1912"]) & pd.Series(other, index=gz.index)
            & k_mai.str.replace(" ", "").str.len().ge(MAI_NEV_MIN_LEN) & ~swapped)
    majo_keys = pd.DataFrame({"m": gz["megye_id"], "k": k_majo})[gz["majo_name"].notna()]
    taken = set(map(tuple, majo_keys.values))
    mai_n = pd.DataFrame({"m": gz["megye_id"], "k": k_mai}).value_counts().to_dict()
    ok = [p and (m, k) not in taken and mai_n.get((m, k), 0) == 1 for p, m, k in zip(pick, gz["megye_id"], k_mai)]
    return gz.loc[ok, ["idtel", "mai_nev"]].set_axis(["idtel", "form"], axis=1).assign(source="mai_nev")


def build_gazetteer_sk(backbone: pd.DataFrame, majo: pd.DataFrame, parts: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
                       gista: dict | None = None, earlier: pd.DataFrame | None = None) -> dict:
    """``{"gazetteer", "forms", "majo_join", "parts", "label_swaps", "subcarpathian_units", "town_surround"}``.

    *majo* = ``data/final/geo/settlements_hu_1910`` (lexikon_sk.build_crosswalk_sk); *parts* =
    :func:`lexikon_sk.parse_parts_sk` (or ``None``: tier ``part_parent_pop`` then joins nothing); *earlier* =
    :func:`lexikon_sk.parse_earlier_years` (or ``None``: no label-swap check)."""
    from utils.parsing import records_geo_hu as rgh
    gista = load_gista() if gista is None else gista
    alls = gista_settlements(gista, backbone)
    scope = gazetteer_scope(alls)
    swaps = majo_label_swaps(majo, earlier if RULES["label_swaps"] else None)
    mj = join_majo(scope, majo, parts, backbone, swaps)
    var = gista_variants(gista)
    scope["variants_1900_1914"] = scope["idtel"].map(
        var.groupby("idtel")["form"].agg(lambda s: "; ".join(dict.fromkeys(s))))
    nev_swaps = mai_nev_swaps(scope, mj)                    # 1.0.2: crosswise MAI NEV swaps, GISta's side
    if RULES["swap_crosswise"]:                             # 1.0.3: GISta's swap joins Majo crosswise (swap_pop)
        mj = join_swaps(mj, nev_swaps, scope)
    one = mj.dropna(subset=["idtel"]).set_index("idtel")
    scope["majo_name"] = scope["idtel"].map(one["obec_sk"])
    scope["majo_join"] = scope["idtel"].map(one["majo_join"])
    scope["majo_pop"] = scope["idtel"].map(one["pop_total"])
    sub = subcarpathian_units(alls, backbone)
    scope["subcarpathian"] = scope["unit_id"].isin(sub) | (~scope["in_backbone"] & (scope["mai_orszag"] == "Ukrajna"))
    over = override_country(scope)                          # 1.0.2: Majo-joined = today's Slovakia
    scope["mai_nev_swapped"] = scope["idtel"].isin(set(nev_swaps.loc[nev_swaps["side"] == "gista", "idtel"]))
    meta = backbone.drop_duplicates("unit_id").set_index("unit_id")
    scope["unit_name_sk"] = scope["unit_id"].map(meta["name_sk"])
    scope["unit_type"] = scope["unit_id"].map(meta["unit_type"])
    twins = set(rgh.build_jaras_twin_pairs(backbone))
    return {"gazetteer": scope.reset_index(drop=True), "forms": _forms(scope, var, backbone), "majo_join": mj,
            "parts": parts, "label_swaps": swaps, "subcarpathian_units": sub, "mai_orszag_overrides": over,
            "mai_nev_swaps": nev_swaps, "town_surround": town_surrounding_jaras(alls, backbone, twins)}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# The link
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#: Lands a cell may name that put the birth outside the Hungarian frame: records_geo's text markers for the
#: foreign lands, plus the Czech crown lands (records_geo reaches those through an okres, not a marker).
OTHER_LANDS = frozenset({"Austria", "Galicia", "Germany", "Russia", "Croatia", "Balkans", "Poland", "Overseas"})
_CZECH_LAND_WORDS = re.compile(r"(?<![a-z])(cechy|cechach|morava|morave|slezsko|slezsku|bohmen|mahren|schlesien)"
                               r"(?![a-z])")
# A region word the cell asserts (not followed by "?", the editor's guess "Slovensko ?"): Podkarpatská Rus must
# hold a settlement in today's Ukraine, Slovensko one outside it (GISta MAI ORSZAG).
_REGION_SUB = re.compile(r"podkarpatsk(?![\w\s]*\?)")
_REGION_SK = re.compile(r"(?<![a-z])slovensk[oua](?![a-z])(?!\s*\?)")
_PAREN = re.compile(r"\(([^()]*)\)")
_PIECES = re.compile(r"[,;/]| - | nebo ")


def cell_head(raw) -> str:
    """A VÚA cell without its parentheses (the card's own text, before the editor's readings)."""
    if raw is None or (not isinstance(raw, str) and pd.isna(raw)):
        return ""
    s = str(raw)
    while _PAREN.search(s):
        s = _PAREN.sub(" ", s)
    return s.replace("(", " ").replace(")", " ")


_HALIC_PIECES = frozenset({"halic", "stara halic"})
NOGRAD = "M17"   # Nógrád (Novohrad) county: the Halič járás and its Stará Halič (Gácsfalu)
# A land word can also be the name of a village of the frame (*Bukovina* in Liptov, *Bukovinka* in Bereg, the village
# *Čechy* = Csehi): a marker on the record's own municipality is the village, not the land (_guard_text).


def _bare_halic(text: str, stara: bool = True) -> bool:
    """The only Galicia marker is a piece that reads *Halič* or (*stara*, 1.0.1) *Stará Halič* alone (or ``okres
    Halič``): the Novohrad district and its village."""
    ks = [_norm(p).strip(" ?.+" if stara else " ?.") for p in _PIECES.split(text)]
    ks = [re.sub(r"^(?:okres|okr\.?)\s+", "", k) for k in ks if k]
    allowed = _HALIC_PIECES if stara else {"halic"}
    return bool(allowed & set(ks)) and not re.search(r"halici|haliči|bukovin", _norm(text))


def _guard_text(text: str, muni_key: str = "") -> str:
    """The cell's text as the land guard reads it: the record's own municipality piece dropped (*muni_key*, set
    only when that municipality is a settlement of the birth's county), and a word the editor marked with ``?``
    dropped (``Morava ?``, ``Halič ?``: a guess, as ``_REGION_*`` already read it)."""
    pieces = [p for p in _PIECES.split(str(text)) if not (muni_key and key_plain(p) == muni_key)]
    t = ", ".join(pieces)
    return re.sub(r"[^\s,;()]+\s*\?", " ", t)


def another_land(text, halic_unit: bool = False, muni_key: str = "", district: bool = False) -> str | None:
    """The land a cell names when it is not the Hungarian frame (records_geo's markers + the Czech lands); ``None``
    else. Never on a Czech letter (ř, ů) alone, never on a bare *Halič* / *Stará Halič* piece when the birth sits
    in Nógrád (*halic_unit*: the Halič járás, or anywhere in the county since 1.0.1), never on the record's own
    municipality (*muni_key*) or a word followed by ``?`` (:func:`_guard_text`). *Ukrajina* alone is today's
    country, not Russia; *Solnohrad* beside a resolved district (*district*) is Solivar (German *Salzburg*)."""
    new = RULES["land_guards"]
    raw = _guard_text(text, muni_key) if new else str(text)
    k = _norm(raw)
    if not k:
        return None
    if _CZECH_LAND_WORDS.search(k):
        return "Czech lands"
    for rx, land in _LAND_MARKER_RES:
        if land not in OTHER_LANDS or not rx.search(k):
            continue
        if land == "Galicia" and halic_unit and _bare_halic(raw, new):
            continue
        if not new:
            return land
        if land == "Russia" and not rx.search(re.sub(r"(?<![a-z])ukrajin\w*", " ", k)):
            continue                                     # 1.0.1: Ukrajina is the record's modern-country note
        if land == "Austria" and district and not rx.search(re.sub(r"(?<![a-z])solnohrad\w*", " ", k)):
            continue                                     # 1.0.1: Solnohrad, okres Prešov = Solivar (Salzburg)
        return land
    return None


# hungarian_labels (1.0.2): the editor's label words before a Hungarian name, misspelt ones included (dřive, díve,
# dřéve), each a whole word, with or without a colon, any number in a row (dříve: též Nagybodak)
_HU_LABELS = re.compile(r"^(?:(?:dříve|dřive|díve|dřív|dřéve|též|dnes|později)(?![^\W\d_])\s*:?\s*)+",
                        re.IGNORECASE)


def hungarian_names(raw) -> list[str]:
    """The names in a VÚA cell's parentheses that are not readings: ``(dříve: Somosújfalu)``, ``(Szölös;
    Nagyszöllös)``, ``(Farkasudvar, Farkas-Dovorán)``. A part naming an okres is a reading, one marked
    ``nesprávně`` (wrong) is dropped, a trailing ``- ?`` is removed."""
    out: list[str] = []
    s = "" if raw is None or (not isinstance(raw, str) and pd.isna(raw)) else str(raw)
    for grp in re.findall(r"\(([^()]*)\)", s):
        items = [i for i in grp.split(";")                  # an item naming an okres is a reading, and one
                 if not re.search(r"\bokr(?:es|\.)?\b|nesprávně|nespravne", i, re.IGNORECASE)]   # marked wrong
        for part in (p for i in items for p in i.split(",")):
            p = part.strip()
            if not p:
                continue
            if RULES["hungarian_labels"]:                 # 1.0.2: a label run, colon or not (dříve: též X)
                p = _HU_LABELS.sub("", p)
            else:
                p = re.sub(r"^(?:dříve(?:\s+též)?|též|dnes)\s*:\s*", "", p, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
            p = re.sub(r"\s*-?\s*\?+\s*$", "", p).strip(" -")
            if re.search(r"[A-Za-zÀ-ž]{3,}", p):
                out.append(p)
    return list(dict.fromkeys(out))


class Index:
    """The gazetteer's name forms by (source group, key kind) -> key -> ids, and the ids by unit and county."""

    GROUPS = {"slovak": ("majo", "backbone"), "today": ("mai_nev",), "hungarian": HUNGARIAN_SOURCES}

    def __init__(self, gz: pd.DataFrame, forms: pd.DataFrame, backbone: pd.DataFrame,
                 parts: pd.DataFrame | None = None):
        self.gz = gz.set_index("idtel")
        if RULES["mai_nev_swaps"] and "mai_nev_swapped" in gz.columns:     # 1.0.2: a swapped MAI NEV names nothing
            swapped = set(gz.loc[gz["mai_nev_swapped"].astype(bool), "idtel"])
            forms = forms[~(forms["source"].eq("mai_nev") & forms["idtel"].isin(swapped))]
        self.by: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, set]] = {}
        for grp, srcs in self.GROUPS.items():
            f = forms[forms["source"].isin(srcs)]
            for kind in ("key_acc", "key_plain", "key_compact"):
                d: dict[str, set] = {}
                vals = f["key_plain"].map(compact) if kind == "key_compact" else f[kind]
                for k, i in zip(vals, f["idtel"]):
                    if k:
                        d.setdefault(k, set()).add(i)
                self.by[(grp, kind)] = d
        self.unit = gz.groupby("unit_id")["idtel"].agg(set).to_dict()
        meta = backbone.drop_duplicates("unit_id").set_index("unit_id")["megye_id"]
        self.megye_of_unit = meta.to_dict()
        gz_m = gz["unit_id"].map(self.megye_of_unit).fillna(gz["megye_id"])
        self.megye_of = dict(zip(gz["idtel"], gz_m))
        self.county = pd.Series(list(self.megye_of.keys())).groupby(pd.Series(list(self.megye_of.values()))) \
            .agg(set).to_dict()
        self.all = set(gz["idtel"])
        names = backbone["name_sk"] if "name_sk" in backbone.columns else pd.Series("", index=backbone.index)
        self.halic_units = set(backbone.loc[names.map(_norm).eq("halic"), "unit_id"])
        sl = forms[forms["source"].isin(("majo", "backbone", "mai_nev"))]
        self.fuzzy_keys = sl.groupby("idtel")["key_plain"].agg(set).to_dict()
        self.slovak_keys = sl[["idtel", "key_plain"]].drop_duplicates()
        self.slovak_heads = _form_heads(sl)
        self.lookups = county_lookups(backbone) if "name_sk" in backbone.columns else None
        self.town_units = set(backbone.loc[backbone["unit_type"] != "járás", "unit_id"])
        self.hungary_today = set(gz.loc[gz["mai_orszag"].isin(HUNGARY_TODAY), "idtel"]) \
            if "mai_orszag" in gz.columns else set()
        self._sound_index(forms)
        self.part_parents = _part_parents(parts)
        self._borders: dict | None = None

    def _sound_index(self, forms: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
        """1.1.0: ``sound_ids`` (sound key -> settlements) and ``sound_keys`` (settlement -> its sound keys) over every
        form — a Hungarian form on :func:`sound_key_hu`, any other on :func:`sound_key_sk`, and ``MAI NEV`` on both (today's
        Ukrainian names are Hungarian-spelt transliterations)."""
        hu = forms["source"].isin(HUNGARIAN_SOURCES)
        keys = [sound_key_hu(f) if h else sound_key_sk(f) for f, h in zip(forms["form"], hu)]
        ids = list(forms["idtel"])
        mai = forms[forms["source"].eq("mai_nev")]
        keys += [sound_key_hu(f) for f in mai["form"]]
        ids += list(mai["idtel"])
        self.sound_ids: dict[str, set] = {}
        self.sound_keys: dict[str, set] = {}
        for k, i in zip(keys, ids):
            if k:
                self.sound_ids.setdefault(k, set()).add(i)
                self.sound_keys.setdefault(i, set()).add(k)

    @property
    def borders(self) -> dict:
        """1.1.0 (``border_unit``): ``{unit: bordering units}`` (:func:`jaras_borders`), read on first use; a test may
        set it."""
        if self._borders is None:
            self._borders = jaras_borders()
        return self._borders

    @borders.setter
    def borders(self, value: dict) -> None:
        self._borders = value

    def sound_exact(self, names: list[str], hu: list[str]) -> tuple[set, str | None]:
        """1.1.0 (``sound_exact``): ``(settlements, group)`` the record's names (:func:`sound_key_sk`) and the cell's
        Hungarian names (:func:`sound_key_hu`) name on the sound key, over the whole gazetteer; *group* ``hungarian``
        when only a Hungarian name reached them, else ``slovak``."""
        sk = {sound_key_sk(n) for n in names if key_plain(n)} - {""}
        hk = {sound_key_hu(h) for h in hu} - {""}
        by_sk = set().union(*[self.sound_ids.get(k, set()) for k in sk]) if sk else set()
        by_hu = set().union(*[self.sound_ids.get(k, set()) for k in hk]) if hk else set()
        return by_sk | by_hu, ("slovak" if by_sk else "hungarian" if by_hu else None)

    def sound_near(self, name: str, region: set, county: set) -> str | None:
        """1.1.0 (``sound_near``): the one settlement of *county* scoring >= :data:`FUZZY_CUTOFF` on the sound key
        (:func:`sound_key_sk` of the record name, of :data:`SOUND_MIN_LEN` letters or more), when it lies in *region*
        and no other settlement of the county has a sound key that holds the record's, or is held by it, with two
        letters to spare (both keys :data:`SOUND_MIN_LEN` long or more: a containing name competes, as in
        :meth:`fuzzy_scan`). A held or holding key never scores."""
        k = sound_key_sk(name)
        if len(k) < SOUND_MIN_LEN:
            return None
        hits, contained = [], set()
        for i in county:
            best = 0.0
            for x in self.sound_keys.get(i, ()):
                if (k in x or x in k) and abs(len(x) - len(k)) >= 2:
                    if min(len(x), len(k)) >= SOUND_MIN_LEN:
                        contained.add(i)
                    continue
                best = max(best, fuzz.ratio(k, x))
            if best >= FUZZY_CUTOFF:
                hits.append(i)
        if len(hits) != 1 or hits[0] not in region or contained - set(hits):
            return None
        return hits[0]

    def hyphen_part(self, muni, region: set) -> str | None:
        """1.1.0 (``hyphen_part``): a VÚA municipality ``A-B`` (an unspaced hyphen, two pieces) where Majo's 1910.2 parts
        give *B* as a part of *A* (*Gôtoväny-Fiačice*: Fiačice, today a part of Gôtoväny): the one settlement of
        *region* *B* names (by name, every form), else ``None``."""
        if not isinstance(muni, str):
            return None
        pieces = [p.strip() for p in _HYPHEN.split(clean_name(muni))]
        if len(pieces) != 2 or not all(pieces) or not region:
            return None
        a, b = pieces
        parents = set().union(*[self.part_parents.get(key_plain(v), set()) for v in name_variants(b)])
        if not parents & {key_plain(v) for v in name_variants(a)}:
            return None
        s, _, _ = self.search([b], region)
        return next(iter(s)) if len(s) == 1 else None

    def prefix(self, names: list[str], region: set) -> set:
        """1.0.1 (``prefix_unit``): the settlements of *region* a Slovak or today's name of which starts with a
        record name plus a space (*Stráže* -> *Stráže nad Myjavou*); names under :data:`PREFIX_MIN_LEN` letters
        none. 1.0.2 (``prefix_heads``): only the head of a ``<name> nad/pod/pri …`` form or of a double-name obec
        (*Zárieč - Keblov*), :func:`_form_heads`; (``county_adjective``) also the one ``<county adjective> <name>``
        form (*Liptovská Porúbka*)."""
        keys = {key_plain(v) for n in names for v in name_variants(n) if len(key_plain(v)) >= PREFIX_MIN_LEN}
        if not keys or not region:
            return set()
        out: set = set()
        if RULES["prefix_heads"]:
            h = self.slovak_heads[self.slovak_heads["idtel"].isin(region)]
            out |= set(h.loc[h["head"].isin(keys), "idtel"])
        else:
            heads = {k + " " for k in keys}
            f = self.slovak_keys[self.slovak_keys["idtel"].isin(region)]
            out |= set(f.loc[f["key_plain"].map(lambda k: any(k.startswith(x) for x in heads)), "idtel"])
        if RULES["county_adjective"]:
            h = self.slovak_heads[self.slovak_heads["idtel"].isin(region)]
            out |= set(h.loc[h["adj_tail"].isin(keys), "idtel"])
        return out

    def search(self, names: list[str], region: set, groups=("slovak", "today", "hungarian")):
        """``(ids, group, accent_only)``: the first group with a hit in *region*, accent-keeping keys before plain."""
        variants = [v for n in names for v in name_variants(n)]
        for grp in groups:
            for kind, accent_only in (("key_acc", False), ("key_plain", True), ("key_compact", True)):
                keyf = {"key_acc": key_acc, "key_plain": key_plain, "key_compact": key_compact}[kind]
                hits = set().union(*[self.by[(grp, kind)].get(keyf(v), set()) for v in variants]) & region \
                    if variants else set()
                if hits:
                    return hits, grp, accent_only
        return set(), None, False

    def fuzzy(self, name: str, region: set, county: set) -> str | None:
        """The one settlement of *region* scoring >= :data:`FUZZY_CUTOFF`, when no other of *county* does. A name
        that only gains or loses a syllable around the other (*Kostolany* inside *Zakostoľany*) is another word,
        not a spelling: a key contained in the other with two letters or more to spare does not count. Since 1.0.3
        (``fuzzy_contained``) such a containing name that shares a word of :data:`FUZZY_SHARED_WORD` letters with the
        record is a competitor (:meth:`fuzzy_scan`), and a competitor leaves no pick."""
        hits, comps = self.fuzzy_scan(name, county)
        return hits[0] if len(hits) == 1 and hits[0] in region and not comps else None

    def fuzzy_scan(self, name: str, county: set) -> tuple[list, list]:
        """``(hits, competitors)`` of *county* for the record *name* (:meth:`fuzzy`): the settlements scoring >=
        :data:`FUZZY_CUTOFF` on a form, and (1.0.3 ``fuzzy_contained``) the others with a form that holds the record's
        key, or is held by it, with two letters to spare and shares a word of :data:`FUZZY_SHARED_WORD` letters or more
        with it (*Šutovce*: *Dolné Šútovce*; *Bystrica*: *Banská Bystrica*; *Velké Volkovce*: *Volkovce*) — unless the
        near names carry that word themselves (a word of theirs starts with its stem: *Stebník-Húta* is *Stebnícka
        Huta*, not *Stebník*)."""
        k = key_plain(name)
        if len(k) < 5:
            return [], []
        words = _long_words(k)
        hits, shared = [], {}
        for i in county:
            best, common = 0.0, set()
            for x in self.fuzzy_keys.get(i, {""}):
                if (k in x or x in k) and abs(len(x) - len(k)) >= 2:
                    common |= (words & _long_words(x)) if RULES["fuzzy_contained"] else set()
                    continue
                best = max(best, fuzz.ratio(k, x))
            if best >= FUZZY_CUTOFF:
                hits.append(i)
            elif common:
                shared[i] = common
        # a shared word the near name carries too (its stem starts a word of it) is no evidence against it: Borský
        # Svätý Jur keeps Borský Svätý Jur beside Svätý Jur, Lehotka pod Brehy its Lehôtka pod Brehmi beside Brehy
        hit_words = {w for i in hits for x in self.fuzzy_keys.get(i, ()) for w in x.replace("-", " ").split()}
        comps = [i for i, ws in shared.items() if any(not any(h.startswith(w[:-1]) for h in hit_words) for w in ws)]
        return sorted(hits), sorted(comps)


_RIVER = re.compile(r"\s+(?:nad|pod|pri)\s+", re.IGNORECASE)


def _long_words(k: str) -> set[str]:
    """1.0.3 (``fuzzy_contained``): the words of a plain key of :data:`FUZZY_SHARED_WORD` letters or more."""
    return {w for w in re.split(r"[^a-z]+", k) if len(w) >= FUZZY_SHARED_WORD}


# fuzzy_adjective_only (1.0.3): positional and size adjectives (de-accented, any gender, Czech -í and old -ia/-ie)
_POSITIONAL = re.compile(r"^(?:horn|doln|vysn|nizn|stredn|velk|vel|mal|nov|star|svat)(?:y|a|e|i|ia|ie)$")


def adjective_only(name) -> bool:
    """1.0.3 (``fuzzy_adjective_only``): every word of *name* is a positional or size adjective (*Horné*, *Veľké*) or a
    county adjective (*Spišský*, records_geo_hu's reader) — a name too thin for a near-name match."""
    ws = key_plain(name).replace("-", " ").split()
    return bool(ws) and all(_POSITIONAL.match(w) or _county_adjective_word(w) for w in ws)


def _county_adjective_word(w: str) -> bool:
    """1.0.3: a de-accented word that is a county adjective by its ending (*spisska*, *liptovsky*, *nitrianske*:
    records_geo_hu's ``_ADJ_END`` + county-adjective tables) — never a bare county noun (*Šariš*, *Veľký Šaryš*)."""
    from utils.parsing import records_geo_hu as rgh
    m = rgh._ADJ_END.match(w)
    return bool(m) and (m.group(1) + "ska") in {**rgh._COUNTY_ADJ, **rgh._COUNTY_ADJ_S2}


def _form_heads(forms: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """``idtel, head, adj_tail`` per Slovak form (1.0.2): ``head`` the plain key before `` nad/pod/pri `` (*Stráže
    nad Myjavou*) or before the hyphen of a double-name obec (*Zárieč - Keblov*, *Výčapy-Opatovce*), else empty;
    ``adj_tail`` the plain key after a first word that is a county adjective (*Liptovská Porúbka* -> *porubka*;
